Authors: Adam Lee, Mutian Xu, Yukang Cao, Shulin Tian, Ziwei Liu

SmolVLA-MoE: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Efficient Multi-Task Robotic Manipulation VLA

Mixture-of-Experts Vision-Language-Action model robotic manipulation efficient inference LIBERO benchmark

简要说明：SmolVLA-MoE 在轻量级 VLA 模型的动作专家中引入稀疏专家混合（MoE）设计，在 LIBERO 基准上提升了多任务操作性能，同时保持相近的推理效率。

TLDR: SmolVLA-MoE introduces a sparse Mixture-of-Experts design into the action expert of a lightweight VLA model, improving multi-task manipulation performance on LIBERO with minimal added inference cost.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promising results in multi-task robotic manipulation by leveraging visual and language understanding for action generation. However, existing lightweight VLA models employ a single dense action expert to handle all tasks, which limits their multi-task capability under constrained computational budgets. To address this issue, we propose SmolVLA-MoE, a novel framework that introduces sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) into the FFN layers of the action expert in VLA models. SmolVLA-MoE replaces dense FFN layers with multiple parallel expert FFNs and a token-level router, enabling each token to adaptively select the most suitable expert for action generation. We further introduce a shared expert with a tunable weight parameter to balance the inheritance of pre-trained capabilities and task-specific expert specialization. Through sparse activation, SmolVLA-MoE activates only a single expert FFN during inference, with a total activated parameter count of approximately 500M including the frozen VLM backbone, while benefiting from approximately 800M total stored parameters. We evaluate our method on four task suites of the LIBERO benchmark. SmolVLA-MoE achieves an average success rate of 84.25%, outperforming SmolVLA (82.75%) and OpenVLA-7B (76.5%), while maintaining comparable inference efficiency. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用视觉和语言理解生成动作，在多任务机器人操作中展现出显著效果。然而，现有的轻量级VLA模型采用单一的密集动作专家处理所有任务，这在有限的计算预算下限制了其多任务能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SmolVLA-MoE，一种新颖的框架，将稀疏混合专家（MoE）引入VLA模型动作专家中的前馈神经网络（FFN）层。SmolVLA-MoE用多个并行的专家FFN和token级路由器替代密集FFN层，使每个token能够自适应地选择最适合动作生成的专家。我们进一步引入一个具有可调权重参数的共享专家，以平衡预训练能力的继承与任务特定专家的专业化。通过稀疏激活，SmolVLA-MoE在推理时仅激活单个专家FFN，包括冻结的VLM主干网络在内，总激活参数约为5亿，同时受益于约8亿的总存储参数。我们在LIBERO基准的四个任务套件上评估了我们的方法。SmolVLA-MoE实现了84.25%的平均成功率，优于SmolVLA（82.75%）和OpenVLA-7B（76.5%），同时保持相当的推理效率。我们的代码已在https://github.com/dudu435/smolvla-moe公开。

Authors: Shiyang Zhang, Miao Yang, Zhengda Li, Yang Shao, Ruifang Zhai, Hui Peng, Peng Song

DiffDreamer: Coupling World Models with Differentiable Simulation for Agile Quadrotor Control RLRobot

world model differentiable simulation quadrotor control reinforcement learning agile flight

简要说明：DiffDreamer将学习的世界模型与可微分仿真相结合，用于四旋翼控制，在激进跟踪和动态门竞赛任务中提高了训练收敛性和最终性能，并经过实际飞行验证。

TLDR: DiffDreamer couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for quadrotor control, improving training convergence and final performance in aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing tasks, with real-world validation.

Abstract: Tasks such as quadrotor dynamic-gate racing require agents to anticipate external motion while maintaining precise high-frequency control. World-model-based reinforcement learning provides a natural solution by learning latent dynamics for future imagination, yet it often entangles environmental evolution and the robot's own dynamics in a single learned rollout, where model bias can affect policy optimization efficiency. We propose DiffDreamer, a differentiable reinforcement learning framework that tightly couples a learned world model with differentiable simulation for actor optimization. In one optimization step, the learned world model propagates latent states that capture external dynamics and history-dependent features, while the differentiable simulator propagates the robot's explicit physical state. We further decompose the actor objective into a critic-driven pathway for non-differentiable task rewards and a simulator-driven pathway for differentiable motion rewards. Experiments on aggressive tracking and dynamic-gate racing show that DiffDreamer improves training convergence over the model-free, model-based, and differentiable-RL baselines, and final performance over these baselines and classical planning and control methods. Additional experiments assess reward decomposition and the odometry-conditioned relative-state representation through ablations. We also provide proof-of-concept real-world flight experiments for validation.

摘要（中文）：摘要：诸如四旋翼动态门竞速等任务，要求智能体在保持精确高频控制的同时预测外部运动。基于世界模型的强化学习通过学习隐式动力学以实现未来想象，为上述问题提供了自然解决方案，但该方法往往将环境演化与机器人自身动力学耦合在单一的学习展开过程中，导致模型偏差可能影响策略优化的效率。我们提出DiffDreamer，一种可微强化学习框架，将学习到的世界模型与可微仿真紧密耦合，用于智能体优化。在单步优化中，学习到的世界模型传播捕捉外部动力学和依赖历史状态特征的隐状态，而可微仿真器则传播机器人显式的物理状态。我们进一步将智能体的目标函数分解为两条路径：基于评论家的路径处理不可微的任务奖励，以及基于仿真器的路径处理可微的运动奖励。在激进跟踪和动态门竞速实验中的结果表明，DiffDreamer在训练收敛速度上优于无模型、基于模型和可微强化学习基线方法，并在最终性能上超过这些基线方法以及经典规划与控制方法。进一步的实验通过消融研究评估了奖励分解和基于里程计条件的相对状态表示。我们还提供了概念验证的真实世界飞行实验以进行验证。

Authors: Fanxing Li, Yuxiang Huang, Shengyang Wang, Fangyu Sun, Shuyu Wu, Tianbao Zhang, Dexin Zuo, Yan Yufei, Danping Zou, Wenxian Yu

SCOPE: Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction for Robot Long-term Planning Datasets Other

TAMP dataset generation scene graph construction LLM fine-tuning plan feedback error-correction diversity metrics

简要说明：SCOPE 是一个自动化框架，用于生成多样且可执行的机器人长期规划（TAMP）数据集，通过利用规划器执行失败来修正场景图中的逻辑不一致，从而提升下游 LLM 微调模型的任务成功率。

TLDR: SCOPE is an automated framework that generates diverse and executable Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) datasets for fine-tuning LLMs, using planner execution failures to correct scene-graph inconsistencies and improve downstream plan success rates.

Abstract: Task and Motion Planning (TAMP) stands as a fundamental challenge in robotics, essential for enabling autonomous agents to execute complex, long-horizon tasks in diverse environments. While Large Language Models (LLMs) introduce a new paradigm for TAMP by leveraging extensive common sense, their inherent reasoning limitations hinder direct application, and fine-tuning strategies to enhance these capabilities are currently bottlenecked by the scarcity of high-quality datasets. Existing automated generation methods often suffer from homogeneity, limiting model generalization, and unsolvability, where hallucinated scene graphs create physical mismatches with task goals. To address these issues, we propose Scene-graph Construction Optimized by Plan Error-correction (SCOPE), an automated framework designed to generate diverse and executable TAMP datasets. SCOPE incorporates multi-level diversity metrics to maximize the information entropy of scenarios. Crucially, it introduces a Plan Feedback Error-correction pipeline that utilizes planner execution failures as feedback signals to retroactively rectify logical inconsistencies in scene graphs, ensuring physical feasibility. Experimental results demonstrate that SCOPE exhibits greater robustness to erroneous scene graphs and generates higher-quality data. When utilized for LLM fine-tuning, SCOPE-generated data yield a downstream TAMP model that achieves an absolute 12.33% gain in success rate over its counterpart fine-tuned with data generated by DELTA, a state-of-the-art PDDL-based planner.

摘要（中文）：任务与运动规划（TAMP）是机器人学中的一项基础性挑战，对于使自主智能体能够在多样化环境中执行复杂的长时域任务至关重要。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）通过利用广泛的常识为TAMP引入了新的范式，但其固有的推理局限性阻碍了直接应用，而增强这些能力的微调策略目前受限于高质量数据集的稀缺。现有的自动化生成方法常常存在同质性问题，限制了模型的泛化能力，以及不可解性问题，即幻觉场景图与任务目标之间产生物理层面的不匹配。为解决这些问题，我们提出了基于计划错误校正优化的场景图构建框架（SCOPE），这是一种自动化框架，旨在生成多样化且可执行的TAMP数据集。SCOPE引入了多层次多样性度量，以最大化场景的信息熵。关键在于，它创新性地提出了一种计划反馈错误校正流水线，利用规划器执行失败作为反馈信号，反向修正场景图中的逻辑不一致性，从而确保物理可行性。实验结果表明，SCOPE对错误的场景图展现出更强的鲁棒性，并能生成更高质量的数据。当用于LLM微调时，通过SCOPE生成的数据所训练的下游TAMP模型，相较于使用当前最先进的基于PDDL的规划器DELTA生成的数据微调得到的模型，成功率绝对提升了12.33%。

Authors: Chaoyue Li, Zeyu Gao, Yanfeng Lu, Fan Luo

Point-Level Refinable Semantic Mapping for Spatial Understanding Perception3D

semantic mapping point-level confidence online refinement dynamic environments embodied navigation

简要说明：本文提出一种在线可细化的语义建图框架，通过概率点级置信度更新持续修正物体中心地图中的噪声或过时点，在静态和动态环境中提高了准确性，并支持物体导航和具身问答。

TLDR: This paper introduces an online refinable semantic mapping framework that uses probabilistic point-level confidence updating to continuously correct noisy or outdated 3D points in object-centric maps, improving accuracy in static and dynamic environments and enabling object navigation and embodied QA.

Abstract: Open-vocabulary 3D semantic maps have emerged as a key spatial memory representation for long-horizon robot autonomy, enabling robots to reason about objects, their spatial relationships, and past observations across time. However, existing object-centric semantic maps are primarily designed for static environments and rely on an append-only point integration strategy, where newly observed points are accumulated but previously integrated points are rarely reevaluated. Consequently, perception errors accumulate over time, and outdated points persist after objects move or disappear. Although recent dynamic mapping methods update object-level representations in changing scenes, they do not explicitly revise noisy or obsolete points within each object. We propose an online refinable semantic mapping framework that continuously refines object representations through probabilistic point-level confidence updating. Each object point maintains a confidence score that is updated online using multi-view temporal evidence: consistent observations reinforce reliable points, while inconsistent segmentation masks, depth measurements, and visibility cues suppress spurious and outdated points. Combined with object tracking and re-identification to preserve instance identities under motion and relocation, our framework enables object-centric semantic maps to be continuously refined rather than monotonically accumulated. Experiments demonstrate improved mapping accuracy over the previous method by 3.46% on Replica and 2.55% on ScanNet, show robustness in dynamic environments and under perception noise, and provide an effective spatial memory for object navigation and embodied question-answering with success rates of 82.4% and 76.7%.

摘要（中文）：开放词汇三维语义地图已成为长时程机器人自主操作中的关键空间记忆表征，使机器人能够推理物体、其空间关系以及跨时间的过往观测。然而，现有的以物体为中心的语义地图主要面向静态环境设计，并依赖一种仅追加的点积分策略，即新观测到的点被不断累积，而已积分的点则很少被重新评估。因此，感知误差随时间不断累积，且在物体移动或消失后，过时的点仍然存在。尽管近期的动态建图方法能够在变化场景中更新物体级表征，但它们并未显式修正每个物体内部的噪声点或过时点。我们提出一种在线可精化的语义建图框架，通过概率性的点级置信度更新持续优化物体表征。每个物体点维护一个置信度分数，该分数利用多视角时序证据在线更新：一致的观测会强化可靠点，而不一致的分割掩码、深度测量和可见性线索则会抑制虚假点和过时点。结合物体跟踪与重识别以在运动与重新布置场景下保持实例身份，我们的框架使以物体为中心的语义地图能够持续精化，而非单调累积。实验表明，与先前方法相比，本方法在Replica上建图精度提升3.46%，在ScanNet上提升2.55%，在动态环境和感知噪声条件下展现出鲁棒性，并为物体导航和具身问答提供有效的空间记忆，成功率分别为82.4%和76.7%。

Authors: Taimeng Fu, Yi Du, Zitong Zhan, Qiwei Du, Shaoshu Su, Zhipeng Zhao, Chen Wang

A Sparse Topometric Graph for Scalable Cross-Session Indoor Navigation Other

简要说明：本论文提出一种稀疏拓扑度量图，通过节点级3D几何与边级连通性实现跨会话的鲁棒对齐和室内导航，显著降低内存消耗。

TLDR: This paper proposes a sparse topometric graph for indoor navigation, using node-level 3D geometry and edge-level connectivity to achieve robust cross-session alignment and goal-directed navigation with significantly reduced memory compared to point-level maps.

Abstract: A conventional embodied agent in an indoor environment builds a map by accumulating noisy real-world measurements and results from heavy inference to guide navigation. While the detailed measurements may differ due to scene changes or sensor settings, the unique topological structure of navigable passages or the connectivity between rooms may provide training-free guidance that complements local observations. We propose a sparse topometric graph as an efficient structural representation for robust indoor navigation, alleviating the need for fine-grained matching, which is computationally expensive, memory-intensive, and prone to real-world variations. The map consists of nodes that encode local 3D geometry and distance-weighted edges that capture traversable connectivity. A learned graph-matching network finds consistent subgraph structures across sessions by considering both node-level geometric descriptors and neighborhood connectivity. The holistic contextual matching is robust to local ambiguities caused by weak distinctiveness or repetitive structure, and establishes stable correspondences despite local scene changes, different sensor modalities, or limited spatial overlap. We analyze the practicality of the graph through cross-session point-goal navigation, where a goal specified in a prior reference map must be reached from an unknown initial pose in a later session. Experiments show that our method achieves the highest success rates (77.1% on Gibson and 40.0% under 3D-FRONT scene changes), while reducing memory by more than two orders of magnitude compared to point-level representations. The proposed approach further supports cross-session alignment and goal-directed navigation with strong scalability and robust real-world transfer.

摘要（中文）：室内环境中的传统具身智能体通过累积含噪的真实世界测量数据并进行大量推理来构建地图，以指导导航。尽管由于场景变化或传感器设置不同，详细的测量数据可能有所差异，但可通行通道的独特拓扑结构或房间之间的连通性，能够提供无需训练的引导，从而补充局部观测信息。我们提出了一种稀疏的拓扑度量图，作为一种高效的结构化表示，用于实现鲁棒的室内导航，避免了对计算开销大、内存占用高且易受现实环境变化影响的细粒度匹配的需求。该地图由编码局部三维几何信息的节点和捕获可通行连通性的距离加权边组成。一个经过学习的图匹配网络通过综合考虑节点级几何描述符和邻域连通性，来寻找跨会话间一致的子图结构。这种整体性的上下文匹配对由弱区分性或重复结构引起的局部歧义具有鲁棒性，并且能够在局部场景变化、不同传感器模态或有限空间重叠的情况下建立稳定的对应关系。我们通过跨会话点目标导航来验证该图的实用性，在该任务中，智能体需要在后续会话中从未知的初始位姿出发，到达先前参考地图中指定的目标位置。实验表明，我们的方法在Gibson数据集上取得了77.1%的成功率，在3D-FRONT场景变化下取得了40.0%的成功率，同时在内存占用方面相比点级表示减少了两个数量级以上。所提出的方法进一步支持跨会话对齐和目标导向导航，具有强大的可扩展性和鲁棒的真实环境迁移能力。

Authors: Eun Sun Lee, Minkyun Seo, Gwangtak Bae, Junho Kim, Seunggu Kang, Jaesik Park, Young Min Kim

Probabilistic Energy Modeling Unifies Versatile Swarm Control Other

简要说明：本文提出了一种概率能量建模框架，通过组合可复用的能量项统一多种群体控制任务，使单一分布式策略能够零样本泛化到不同任务、规模和平台，并在仿真和真实空中机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a probabilistic energy modeling framework that unifies diverse swarm control tasks by composing reusable energy terms, enabling a single decentralized policy to generalize zero-shot across missions, scales, and platforms, as validated in simulation and on real aerial robots.

Abstract: Robotic swarms must coordinate across diverse missions, yet existing controllers often require redesign, retuning, or retraining when objectives change. Here we show that probabilistic energy modeling provides a unifying representation for versatile swarm control, in which diverse missions emerge from compositions of shared interaction principles rather than task-specific control formulations. By exploiting the correspondence between Gibbs random field energy minimization and structured reward maximization, we encode fundamental swarm behaviors as reusable energy terms within a unified probabilistic objective. Decentralized policies trained within this representation are composed into a single controller through lightweight policy gating, without retraining. An interpretable action-attention mechanism captures non-uniform local interactions, while dimensionless normalization supports transfer across swarm scales and platforms. Demonstrated on aerial swarms, the unified policy generalizes zero-shot across six mission classes, 10-100 agents, two hardware platforms, and indoor cluttered and GPS-denied woodland environments. Large-scale simulations achieve 0.96-1.00 task success rates with 1-10 ms per-agent inference latency, while physical deployments confirm zero-shot transfer to real platforms and unstructured environments. These results establish probabilistic energy modeling as a scalable and transferable framework for decentralized swarm control.

摘要（中文）：机器人群体必须在多种任务之间进行协调，然而现有控制器在目标变化时往往需要重新设计、重新调参或重新训练。在此，我们证明概率能量建模为多功能群体控制提供了一种统一表示，在该表示中，多样化的任务源于共享交互原则的组合，而非针对特定任务的控制公式。通过利用吉布斯随机场能量最小化与结构化奖励最大化之间的对应关系，我们将基本群体行为编码为统一概率目标中的可复用能量项。在此表示中训练的分散式策略，通过轻量级策略门控被组合为单一控制器，无需重新训练。一种可解释的动作-注意力机制捕捉非均匀的局部交互，而无量纲归一化支持跨群体规模和平台的迁移。在空中群体上的实验表明，该统一策略在六类任务、10-100个智能体、两种硬件平台以及室内杂乱环境和无GPS林地环境中实现了零样本泛化。大规模仿真实现了0.96-1.00的任务成功率，每智能体推理延迟为1-10毫秒，而物理部署确认了向真实平台和非结构化环境的零样本迁移。这些结果确立了概率能量建模作为分散式群体控制的可扩展且可迁移框架。

Authors: Xiang Zhou, Xiangyu Zhu, Xintong Wang, Qingyuan Yang, Rui Huang, Feng Xue, Lin Li, Qingrui Zhang

Whole-Body Motion Guided Reference Generation for Uncertainty-Aware Compliant Assistance Locomotion

exoskeleton trajectory generation uncertainty-aware control admittance control whole-body motion

简要说明：本文提出一种双环外骨骼辅助策略，将基于去噪的多模态轨迹生成与可变导纳控制耦合，利用轨迹方差实现不确定性感知的刚度调节，以提供柔顺辅助。

TLDR: This paper presents a dual-loop exoskeleton assistance strategy that couples multimodal trajectory generation via denoising with variable admittance control, where trajectory variance informs an uncertainty-aware stiffness regulation law for compliant human assistance.

Abstract: Exoskeletons have shown great potential for augmenting human physical capabilities, yet generating reliable assistance remains challenging because human motion patterns and interaction requirements vary substantially in practice. To address this problem, a dual-loop assistance strategy is proposed to couple multimodal exoskeleton trajectory generation with variable admittance control, where trajectory variance links the outer-loop generator and the inner-loop controller. The generator synthesizes future exoskeleton trajectories through denoising, primarily using whole-body human motion and exoskeleton proprioception, with task descriptions as auxiliary semantic cues. To reduce cross-modal representation mismatch, a three-stage training pipeline is introduced to progressively optimize the human motion encoder, the exoskeleton proprioception encoder, and the trajectory generator. In the inner loop, multiple future trajectories are sampled from the generator to estimate the trajectory mean and variance. The mean is used as the control reference, while the variance provides an uncertainty measure for prediction reliability. This measure is further incorporated into a stiffness regulation law, enabling compliant assistance with input-to-state stability under bounded lumped interaction input. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method significantly reduces muscle activation levels compared with standard baselines, while also decreasing users' metabolic energy expenditure relative to the unassisted condition.

摘要（中文）：外骨骼在增强人体物理能力方面展现出巨大潜力，然而在实际应用中，由于人体运动模式和交互需求存在显著差异，生成可靠的辅助力仍面临挑战。为此，提出了一种双环辅助策略，将多模态外骨骼轨迹生成与可变导纳控制相结合，其中轨迹方差连接外环生成器与内环控制器。生成器通过去噪方式合成未来外骨骼轨迹，主要利用全身人体运动与外骨骼本体感觉信息，并以任务描述作为辅助语义线索。为减少跨模态表示不匹配，引入了一个三阶段训练流程，逐步优化人体运动编码器、外骨骼本体感觉编码器和轨迹生成器。在内环中，从生成器中采样多条未来轨迹，以估计轨迹均值与方差。均值用作控制参考，而方差则提供预测可靠性的不确定性度量。该度量进一步被纳入刚度调节律中，在集总交互输入有界的情况下，实现具有输入-状态稳定性的柔顺辅助。实验结果表明，与标准基线方法相比，所提方法显著降低了肌肉激活水平，同时相较于无辅助条件，也减少了使用者的代谢能耗。

Authors: Muyuan Ma, Long Cheng, Lijun Han, Haotian Zhai, Xinpan Meng, Xiuze Xia, Houcheng Li, Zeyu Liu

Learning Robot Behavior Priors from Non-Robotic Synthetic Data Other

robot action prediction synthetic data procedural generation in-context learning Transformers

简要说明：本文研究程序化生成的非机器人合成数据能否为机器人动作预测提供有用的先验，结果表明仅在此类数据上训练的Transformer在未见过的物理机器人任务上取得了非平凡的零样本性能，但不如在特定数据集上训练的等计算量真实机器人数据基线。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether procedurally generated, non-robotic synthetic data can provide useful priors for robot action prediction, showing that a Transformer trained solely on such data achieves non-trivial zero-shot performance on unseen physical robot tasks, albeit worse than compute-matched real-robot training on specific datasets.

Abstract: Real robot data, rich across tasks and morphologies, is often treated as the bottleneck for training robot learning models, including embodied foundation models that aim for zero-shot physical transfer. In this paper, we investigate the degree to which such models can acquire necessary structure using data from systems without embodiment. To this end, we test if inexpensive, procedurally generated synthetic data can yield useful priors before a model observes any real-world behavior. We study this through robot action prediction, a natural pretraining objective and a direct test of whether structure learned from arbitrary synthetic tasks transfers to embodied settings. We introduce three data generation pipelines that model mathematical abstractions of robotic control, and use them as pretraining priors for a Transformer. We demonstrate that a model trained purely on this non-robotic data attains non-trivial zero-shot prediction performance on unseen physical robot tasks via an in-context learning mechanism, and that our specialized control priors notably improve upon generic causal priors. We also compare against a compute-matched baseline trained on real robot data, and find that it outperforms our model but only on the datasets it was trained on. These findings suggest that procedurally generated, mathematical abstractions can yield useful robotic priors, offering a potential complement to expensive embodied data collection.

摘要（中文）：真实机器人数据虽然涵盖丰富的任务和形态，但常被视为训练机器人学习模型（包括旨在实现零样本物理迁移的具身基础模型）的瓶颈。在本文中，我们探究了这些模型在多大程度上能够利用缺乏具身性的系统数据来获取必要的结构信息。为此，我们测试了廉价的、程序化生成的合成数据是否能在模型观察任何真实世界行为之前提供有用的先验知识。我们通过机器人动作预测这一自然预训练目标来展开研究，这同时也是对从任意合成任务中学习到的结构能否迁移至具身场景的直接检验。我们提出了三条数据生成流程，对机器人控制的数学抽象进行建模，并将其作为Transformer的预训练先验。我们证明，仅基于此类非机器人数据训练的模型，能够通过上下文学习机制，在未见过的物理机器人任务上取得非平凡的零样本预测性能，并且我们专门设计的控制先验显著优于通用因果先验。我们还与使用真实机器人数据训练的、计算量匹配的基线模型进行了对比，发现该基线模型在其训练数据集上表现优于我们的模型，但并未展现出跨数据集的泛化能力。这些发现表明，程序化生成的数学抽象能够提供有效的机器人先验，有望成为昂贵的具身数据收集的补充方案。

Authors: Mateusz Odrowaz-Sypniewski, Michael Amir, Jasmine Bayrooti, Ajay Shankar, Amanda Prorok

Inside-JEPA: From Prediction to Relational Grounding in Latent World Models WorldModel

latent world models inverse-dynamics relational grounding JEPA action ranking

简要说明：Inside-JEPA 在潜在世界模型中引入关系通道，通过逆动力学损失进行接地，提升了对机器人动作和视频关系的理解与排序。

TLDR: Inside-JEPA introduces relational channels inside latent world models, grounded via inverse-dynamics, improving relational understanding and action ranking on robot and video data.

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn world models in latent space, enabling efficient planning but leaving their states opaque. We introduce Inside-JEPA, which places relational channels for ordered entity pairs inside the JEPA latent state and shows that an inverse-dynamics loss can ground these channels without relation labels when its head reads them, either alone or as part of the full state. On Something-Something V2, latent prediction alone performs no better than a random relation head, while inverse-dynamics supervision that recovers actions from channel changes improves relational AUROC by .065-.103 across ten settings with annotated boxes, by .081 on RH20T robot episodes with held-out tasks, and by .050-.061 across five relations using off-the-shelf detection and tracking. An inverse head on entity latents decodes actions more accurately but barely improves relational grounding; shuffled labels, two label-free objectives, and action labels on only 5% of the pairs also fail to ground the channels. Given an action, predicted relational changes approach the quality of observed future relations (AUROC .599 vs .621). For one-step relational goals, a supervised readout of the 16 channels ranks the correct action among the top five of 65 in 43% of cases, compared with 24% for prediction-only latents and 17% for a frequency prior.

摘要（中文）：联合嵌入预测架构（JEPAs）在潜空间中学习世界模型，能够实现高效规划，但其状态仍不够透明。我们提出了Inside-JEPA，将有序实体对的关系通道置于JEPA潜状态内部，并证明当逆动力学损失的头模块读取这些通道时——无论是单独读取还是作为完整状态的一部分——该损失可以在无需关系标签的情况下对这些通道进行 grounding。在Something-Something V2数据集上，仅靠潜状态预测的表现并不优于随机关系头模块；而利用通道变化恢复动作的逆动力学监督，在十种带标注框的设置中将关系AUROC提升了.065-.103，在包含保留任务的RH20T机器人片段中提升了.081，在使用现成检测与跟踪的五个关系上提升了.050-.061。在实体潜状态上使用逆动力学头模块解码动作更为准确，但对关系grounding的提升甚微；打乱的标签、两种无标签目标以及仅对5%的实体对提供动作标签也均无法对通道进行grounding。在给定动作的条件下，预测的关系变化接近观测到的未来关系质量（AUROC .599对比.621）。对于单步关系目标，16个通道的监督读头模块在43%的情况下能将正确动作排在65个动作的前五名，而仅用预测的潜状态为24%，频率先验为17%。

Authors: Hossein Resani, Javen Qinfeng Shi

To Route or to Adapt? Multi-Expert Diffusion Planners in Unseen Regions AutonomousDriving

diffusion trajectory planners test-time routing reward-based fine-tuning open-loop offsets nuPlan

简要说明：本文探讨了扩散轨迹规划器在未见区域中应选择现有专家还是通过微调进行适应，发现用20个目标区域场景进行微调能显著改善开环偏移，而路由方案效果不佳。

TLDR: The paper investigates whether diffusion trajectory planners should select among existing experts or adapt via fine-tuning when deployed in unseen regions, finding that adaptation with 20 target-region scenes substantially improves open-loop offsets while routing schemes fail.

Abstract: Diffusion trajectory planners with domain-specific experts face a practical question in unseen regions: can they rely on selecting among existing experts, or must the planner itself adapt? We study this question using a planner with a shared adapter and per-domain expert adapters. Across three real-world held-out maps, none of eight test-time routing schemes improves the fleet-mean lateral offset over the static default, which uses the same expert for every scene. Even an oracle that selects the best expert for each scene reduces the mean offset by only 0.9 m. In contrast, reward-based fine-tuning on just 20 target-region scenes yields substantially larger gains. On matched evaluation slices, joint replay achieves a fleet-mean offset of 6.9 m, compared with 12.4 m for the static default. Comparisons under the same target-region training budget show that target-region training drives the improvement, while replaying training scenes limits forgetting on the original ODDs. On nuPlan, fine-tuning across training cities also improves open-loop offsets, although closed-loop performance deteriorates. Further diagnostics reveal that two test-time adaptation baselines achieve low offsets by producing degenerate trajectories. These results show the limited headroom for selecting among existing experts and the greater open-loop gains available from adapting the planner.

摘要（中文）：扩散轨迹规划器在未见区域中面临一个实际问题：它们能否依赖在现有专家之间进行选择，还是规划器本身必须进行自适应？我们使用一个配备共享适配器和各领域专家适配器的规划器来研究这一问题。在三个真实世界保留地图上，八种测试时路由方案均未能在车队平均横向偏移上优于静态默认方案——后者对每个场景使用相同的专家。即使是一个能够为每个场景选择最佳专家的理想方案，也仅将平均偏移降低了0.9米。相比之下，仅使用20个目标区域场景进行基于奖励的微调便带来了显著更大的改进。在匹配的评估切片上，联合回放实现了6.9米的车队平均偏移，而静态默认方案为12.4米。在相同目标区域训练预算下的比较表明，目标区域训练是改进的主要驱动因素，而回放训练场景则限制了对原始ODD的遗忘。在nuPlan上，跨训练城市的微调同样改善了开环偏移，尽管闭环性能有所下降。进一步的诊断显示，两种测试时自适应基线通过生成退化轨迹来实现较低偏移。这些结果表明，在现有专家之间进行选择的空间有限，而自适应规划器在开环指标上可带来更大的提升。

Authors: Yun Li, Ehsan Javanmardi, Simon Thompson, Jiachen Gong, Qunli Zhang, Zifan Zeng, Shiming Liu, Peng Wang, Yidu Zhang, Manabu Tsukada

AstroBench: Benchmarking Free-Floating Capture and Space Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

free-floating capture space robotic manipulation VLA policy benchmark contact-sensitive control

简要说明：AstroBench 提出了一个用于自由漂浮物体捕获和太空机器人操作的基准，包含任务套件、资产和实验，实验表明通用 VLA 策略迁移效果差，而任务专用策略成功，凸显了对运动感知和接触敏感控制的需求。

TLDR: AstroBench introduces a benchmark for free-floating object capture and space robotic manipulation, with task suites, assets, and experiments showing that a generalist VLA policy transfers poorly while a task-specific policy succeeds, highlighting the need for motion-aware and contact-sensitive control.

Abstract: Capturing a loose object inside a spacecraft requires a robot to approach a target that can translate and rotate, and whose motion changes when contact is made. These conditions motivate evaluation beyond manipulation of supported objects. We introduce AstroBench, an open benchmark for free-floating capture and space robotic manipulation with a fixed-base arm. The task suite combines four initial-motion tracks with sample-storage operations based on MELFI hardware and cap and captive-screw servicing based on the Robotic Refueling Mission. The two workcells provide nine task definitions and 29 task-target combinations. A metadata-filtered Objaverse inventory supplies 8,414 object instances for asset expansion, alongside five cabin visual contexts and versioned task instructions. We report two acquisition-focused experiments using existing checkpoints. A frozen $π_{0.5}$ DROID joint-position policy captures 2 of 200 static targets and 4 of 200 moving targets across twenty object identities. A cube-specific ACT policy captures 8 of 10 static targets and 6 of 10 moving targets in a separate experiment. Each experiment retains its recorded observation, action and capture configuration. The results document difficult direct transfer for the tested generalist checkpoint and successful task-specific capture behavior, while identifying concrete settings for studying motion-aware perception and contact-sensitive control. Code, task definitions and editable workcell assets are available at https://github.com/AstroUpLab/AstroBench.

摘要（中文）：在航天器内部捕获自由漂浮物体，要求机器人接近一个既能平移又能旋转的目标，且该目标的运动会因接触而发生变化。这些条件促使评估不能仅限于对受支撑物体的操作。我们提出了AstroBench，一个面向固定基座机械臂的自由漂浮捕获与空间机器人操作的开源基准。该任务套件将四种初始运动轨迹与基于MELFI硬件的样本存储操作，以及基于“机器人加油任务”的盖子与系留螺钉维护操作相结合。两个工作单元提供了九个任务定义和二十九个任务-目标组合。一个经元数据过滤的Objaverse库存提供了8，414个物体实例用于资产扩展，同时包含五种舱内视觉环境和带版本的任务指令。我们报告了两个基于现有检查点的采集聚焦实验。一个冻结的π₀.₅ DROID关节位置策略在二十个物体身份中捕获了200个静态目标中的2个和200个运动目标中的4个。在另一项独立实验中，一个针对立方体的ACT策略捕获了10个静态目标中的8个和10个运动目标中的6个。每个实验都保留了其记录的观测数据、动作和捕获配置。实验结果记录了所测试的通用检查点在直接迁移中的困难性，以及任务特定捕获行为的成功表现，同时为研究运动感知和接触敏感控制确定了具体设置。代码、任务定义和可编辑工作单元资产可在https://github.com/AstroUpLab/AstroBench获取。

Authors: Zizhe Wang, Jia Deng, Xin Lu, Zehao Jia, Yi Huang, Yao Zhu

Demonstration-Based Robotic Feeding Using Dynamic Movement Primitives Manipulation

robotic feeding dynamic movement primitives demonstration-based vision-based scene perception Kinova Gen3

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于示范的机器人喂食框架，结合了人类示范、动态运动基元、视觉感知和机器人控制，并通过Kinova Gen3机械臂的真实实验验证了该集成流程的有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents a demonstration-based robotic feeding framework that combines human demonstration, Dynamic Movement Primitives, vision-based perception, and robot control. A real-world experiment with a Kinova Gen3 arm validates the integrated pipeline for scooping and feeding motions.

Abstract: This paper presents a demonstration-based robotic feeding framework that integrates human demonstration, Dynamic Movement Primitive-based motion planning, vision-based scene perception, and robot control. A human operator first demonstrates the scooping and feeding motions while the position and Euler-angle orientation of the spoon are recorded using a motion-capture system. The recorded trajectory is segmented into scooping and feeding motions, which are encoded using separate Dynamic Movement Primitives. Before task execution, an RGB-D camera estimates the participant's mouth position, while two AprilTags are used for robot-frame registration and tray localization. The detected tray pose is used to position the scooping motion, whereas the detected mouth position defines the positional goal of the feeding motion. The approach, scooping, and feeding trajectories are then executed sequentially by a Kinova Gen3 manipulator through a ROS~2-based framework. A real-world experiment demonstrates the feasibility of the integrated pipeline and shows that the learned spoon motions can be reproduced within the detected experimental scene.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于示教的机器人喂食框架，该框架融合了人类示教、基于动态运动基元（Dynamic Movement Primitive）的运动规划、基于视觉的场景感知以及机器人控制。操作员首先演示舀取和喂食动作，同时利用动作捕捉系统记录勺子的位置和欧拉角姿态。记录得到的轨迹被分割为舀取动作和喂食动作，并分别使用独立的动态运动基元进行编码。在任务执行前，RGB-D相机估计参与者的嘴部位置，同时使用两个AprilTag进行机器人坐标系注册和托盘定位。检测到的托盘位姿用于定位舀取动作，而检测到的嘴部位置则定义了喂食动作的位置目标。随后，接近、舀取和喂食轨迹由Kinova Gen3机械臂通过基于ROS~2的框架依次执行。实际实验验证了该集成流程的可行性，并表明学习到的勺子运动能够在检测到的实验场景中得到复现。

Authors: Kenzhi Iskandar Wong, Kitti Thamrongaphichartkul, Sri Harsha Turlapati, Yanshuo Lu, Kanichi Doi, Boyu Ma, Bin Zhou, Lin Yang, Ananda Sidarta, Lek Syn Lim, Arun-Kumar Kaliya-Perumal, Jianfei Yang, Domenico Campolo

Revisiting Distribution Matching for State-to-Vision Policy Distillation in Laparoscopic Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

policy distillation vision-based policy laparoscopic robotic manipulation imitation learning reinforcement learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于腹腔镜机器人操作的状态到视觉策略蒸馏框架，利用特权状态教师策略训练基于RGB和本体感觉的视觉学生策略，在模拟环境中比纯RL或IL方法更稳定。

TLDR: This paper proposes a state-to-vision policy distillation framework for laparoscopic robotic manipulation, where a privileged state-based teacher trains a vision-based student from RGB and proprioception, achieving more consistent performance than RL or IL alone.

Abstract: End-to-end control policies trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL) have emerged as an alternative to conventional surgical robotic control approaches, with recent studies exploring state-based policies trained on privileged state observations. However, such approaches rely on precise physical states that are difficult to obtain reliably in surgical environments. Vision-based RL provides an alternative by learning manipulation policies directly from RGB observations, avoiding explicit state estimation and manually engineered perception pipelines while enabling policies to acquire task-relevant visual representations. Nevertheless, obtaining vision-based policies via pure RL methods for surgical manipulation remains challenging. Thus, imitation learning (IL) becomes another solution, yet it requires a large number of expert demonstrations, which are difficult to obtain in minimally invasive surgery. In this work, we propose a framework for state-to-vision policy distillation in laparoscopic robotic manipulation. Specifically, a state-based policy with privileged observations is employed as the teacher, and a vision-based policy learns from RGB observations and robot proprioceptive information, which requires less expert demonstrations than IL and introduces superior performance than RL methods. We conduct extensive experiments on various surgical manipulation tasks in the simulated environment. Experimental results show that, in the context of laparoscopic robotic manipulation, training vision-based policies with general-purpose RL methods is challenging, whereas our proposed state-to-vision policy distillation leads to more consistent and stable performance across tasks.

摘要（中文）：通过强化学习（RL）训练得到的端到端控制策略已成为传统手术机器人控制方法的一种替代方案，近期研究探索了基于特权状态观测训练的状态基策略。然而，此类方法依赖于在手术环境中难以可靠获取的精确物理状态。基于视觉的强化学习提供了一种替代途径，它直接从RGB观测中学习操作策略，避免了显式状态估计和人工设计的感知流程，同时使策略能够获取与任务相关的视觉表征。尽管如此，在手术操作中通过纯强化学习方法获得基于视觉的策略仍然具有挑战性。因此，模仿学习（IL）成为另一种解决方案，但该方法需要大量专家示范，而在微创手术中获取这些示范十分困难。在本研究中，我们提出了一种腹腔镜机器人操作中的状态到视觉策略蒸馏框架。具体而言，采用具有特权观测的状态基策略作为教师，基于视觉的策略则从RGB观测和机器人本体感知信息中学习，该框架相比模仿学习所需的专家示范更少，且性能优于强化学习方法。我们在模拟环境中针对多种手术操作任务进行了大量实验。实验结果表明，在腹腔镜机器人操作场景下，使用通用强化学习方法训练基于视觉的策略具有挑战性，而我们提出的状态到视觉策略蒸馏方法在各任务中表现出更一致且稳定的性能。

Authors: Mingyu Sheng, Jianan Fan, Dongnan Liu, Guoyan Zheng, Ron Kikinis, Weidong Cai

In-Context Learning World Models for Robot Dual-Arm Manipulation of Soft Garment with Partial Observations WorldModel

world model in-context learning garment manipulation dual-arm sim-to-real

简要说明：本文提出一种软物体世界模型，通过在大型模拟数据上训练的Transformer骨干，利用部分点云历史的上下文学习进行生成式全状态估计和动作条件动力学预测，实现无需权重更新的双臂衣物折叠的仿真到现实迁移。

TLDR: This paper presents a Soft-Object World Model that uses a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated data and in-context learning over partial point-cloud histories to perform generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction, enabling sim-to-real bimanual garment folding without weight updates.

Abstract: Robust manipulation of soft objects, such as garments, is a critical skill for service and household robots to adopt, but remains challenging due to its high-dimensional state space, and material-dependent deformations. Humans address this challenge by using mental world models that "imagine" the shape and material properties from partial observations, which enables them to predict how actions affect future states. As such, embedding such world models in robots allows for better generalization in manipulating a wide variety of garments in the real world. However, learned world models typically require large amounts of real world data that is strenuous to collect, and a mechanism to infer latent properties that govern dynamics. We present a Soft-Object World Model that performs generative full-state estimation and action-conditioned dynamics prediction using a transformer backbone trained on large-scale simulated soft object interactions, with measures to mitigate the sim-to-real gap. By learning to infer latent shape and material cues through in-context learning over a variable-length partial point-cloud history, the model generalizes across robot embodiments, material parameters, garment types and shapes, and manipulation coordination modes without weight updates. The world model is then integrated with a Goal-Conditioned action planner for motion synthesis. We validate the approach in simulation and real world for bimanual garment folding, reporting improvements in reconstruction fidelity, prediction accuracy, and task success.

摘要（中文）：对柔软物体（如衣物）的稳健操控是服务机器人和家庭机器人所需掌握的关键技能，但由于其高维状态空间以及依赖材料的变形特性，这一任务仍具挑战性。人类通过利用心理世界模型，从部分观测中“设想”物体的形状和材料属性，从而能够预测动作对未来状态的影响，以此应对上述挑战。因此，将此类世界模型嵌入机器人中，有助于增强其在真实世界中操控多种衣物的泛化能力。然而，学习得到的世界模型通常需要大量难以采集的真实世界数据，以及一种能够推断控制动力学潜在属性的机制。我们提出了一种柔软物体世界模型，该模型基于在大规模仿真柔软物体交互上训练的Transformer主干网络，实现生成式全状态估计和动作条件下的动力学预测，并采取措施缓解仿真到现实的差距。通过基于可变长度部分点云历史的上下文学习，模型能够推断潜在的形状和材料线索，并在无需权重更新的情况下，跨机器人形态、材料参数、衣物类型与形状以及操控协调模式进行泛化。该世界模型进一步与目标条件动作规划器集成，用于运动合成。我们在仿真和真实世界中验证了该方法在双臂衣物折叠任务中的表现，报告了在重建保真度、预测准确性和任务成功率方面的提升。

Authors: Hengyi Sim, Quentin Rouxel, Dennis Hong, Darwin Caldwell, Fei Chen

ProTrav: Probabilistic Traversability with Elevation Uncertainty Propagation for Risk-aware Off-road Navigation Perception3D

probabilistic terrain representation sparse variational Gaussian process elevation uncertainty propagation function-space sampling risk-aware navigation

简要说明：ProTrav提出一种基于稀疏变分高斯过程和函数空间采样的概率可通过性估计方法，将高程不确定性传播至控制器，提升了仿真和真实越野环境中的风险感知导航能力。

TLDR: ProTrav introduces a probabilistic traversability estimation method using sparse variational Gaussian processes and function-space sampling to propagate elevation uncertainty into control, improving risk-aware off-road navigation in simulation and on a real robot.

Abstract: Reliable traversability estimation is essential for autonomous navigation on unstructured terrain. State-of-the-art approaches typically evaluate traversability from deterministic terrain elevation, thereby overlooking spatial correlations in the terrain and failing to account for how elevation uncertainty propagates through nonlinear traversability mappings. We propose ProTrav, a probabilistic terrain representation that uses function-space sampling to generate spatially correlated terrain realizations and propagate elevation uncertainty to traversability cost. First, a Sparse Variational Gaussian Process (SVGP) reconstructs a probabilistic elevation field from observations. Then, posterior function-space sampling generates spatially correlated terrain realizations, preserving spatial dependencies between neighboring locations while propagating elevation uncertainty through geometric features into traversability cost. Consequently, a distribution of traversability cost at arbitrary location is established, where the mean and standard deviation quantify the expected traversability cost and associated uncertainty, respectively. A risk term is defined by moment-based Upper Confidence Bound (UCB) and incorporated into a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller for risk-aware navigation. Simulation experiments demonstrate navigation success rates exceeding 90\% on different terrains, compared with below 40\% for a baseline, while reducing attitude variations. Furthermore, the proposed approach is validated on a robot traversing real-world off-road terrain.

摘要（中文）：可靠的可通行性估计对于非结构化地形上的自主导航至关重要。最先进的方法通常基于确定性地形高程评估可通行性，从而忽略了地形中的空间相关性，且未能考虑高程不确定性如何通过非线性可通行性映射进行传播。我们提出ProTrav，一种概率地形表示方法，利用函数空间采样生成空间相关的地形实现，并将高程不确定性传播至可通行性成本。首先，稀疏变分高斯过程（SVGP）从观测数据中重建概率高程场。随后，后验函数空间采样生成空间相关的实现，保留相邻位置之间的空间依赖性，同时将高程不确定性通过几何特征传播至可通行性成本。由此，在任意位置建立可通行性成本的分布，其中均值和标准差分别量化预期可通行性成本及其相关不确定性。基于矩的上置信界（UCB）定义风险项，并将其纳入模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器以实现风险感知导航。仿真实验表明，在不同地形上的导航成功率超过90%，而基线方法低于40%，同时姿态变化有所减少。此外，所提出方法在实际越野地形上的机器人穿越实验中得到了验证。

Authors: Chuanlin Zuo, Miloš Prágr, Arun Kumar Singh, Mohammad Loni, Reza Ghabcheloo

EBV-CAN: Vision--Language Grounding for Contact-Aided Endoscope Navigation VLA

vision-language-action endoscope navigation contact-aided bird's-eye-view semantic grounding

简要说明：本文提出EBV-CAN，一种用于接触辅助内窥镜导航的视觉-语言策略，结合全局鸟瞰图与内窥镜观测和电机状态，通过语义查询进行定位与动作预测。文章引入VLCA数据集，并展示了相比基线在物理任务成功率上的提升。

TLDR: This paper presents EBV-CAN, a vision-language policy for contact-aided endoscope navigation that combines a global bird's-eye view with endoscopic observations and motor states, using semantic queries for localization and action prediction. It introduces the VLCA dataset and demonstrates improved physical task success over baselines.

Abstract: Flexible endoscopes exploit structural compliance to traverse narrow lumens, pipes, and cavities, where navigation involves distributed environmental contact. This compliance makes tip motion depend on the evolving support configuration. We present external bird's-eye-view contact-aided navigation (EBV-CAN), a vision-language policy that combines one initial global static bird's-eye image with evolving endoscopic observations and motor state. Three supervised semantic queries locate the tip, next waypoint, and instructed target on the cached global image; their residual representations predict bending and insertion commands. We introduce the Vision-Language Contact-Aided (VLCA) dataset, linking 517 demonstrations and 75k action samples to 958k spatial entries and 93k remaining-route records. On 50 held-out episodes, tip-coordinate and waypoint localization reach 97.5% and 94.8%. Swapping the target instruction under identical observations changes target attention and motor output across 17 dual-target episodes. Across 1,920 physical trials of eight policies trained under a shared protocol, EBV-CAN achieves 183/240 successes (76.25%) under automatic blue-area scoring. Gated recurrent unit behavior cloning (GRU-BC) achieves the lowest matched-task offline mean absolute error (MAE), 0.056, and 1/240 physical successes, establishing distinct rankings for action imitation and task completion. Successful multi-guide executions and representative failures connect spatial progress, steering transitions, and visibility to physical navigation.

摘要（中文）：柔性内窥镜利用结构柔顺性穿越狭窄腔道、管道和空腔，其导航过程涉及分布式的环境接触。这种柔顺特性使得尖端运动依赖于不断变化的支撑构型。我们提出外部鸟瞰视角接触辅助导航（EBV-CAN），这是一种视觉-语言策略，将一张初始全局静态鸟瞰图像与动态变化的内窥镜观测图像及电机状态相结合。三个监督式语义查询在缓存的全局图像上定位尖端、下一路径点和指定目标；其残差表示预测弯曲和插入指令。我们引入了视觉-语言接触辅助（VLCA）数据集，将517个演示和75,000个动作样本与958,000个空间条目及93,000条剩余路径记录关联起来。在50个预留测试片段中，尖端坐标和路径点定位分别达到97.5%和94.8%的准确率。在相同观测条件下更换目标指令，会在17个双目标片段中改变目标注意力分布和电机输出。在共享协议下训练的八个策略共1,920次物理实验中，EBV-CAN在自动蓝色区域评分下实现了183/240次成功（76.25%）。门控循环单元行为克隆（GRU-BC）在离线匹配任务中取得了最低的平均绝对误差（MAE）0.056，但在物理实验中仅取得1/240次成功，从而在动作模仿和任务完成两个维度上确立了不同的排名。成功的多引导执行和代表性失败案例将空间进展、转向过渡和可见性与物理导航联系起来。

Continuous-Time Motion Planning and Steering with Global Convergence Other

motion planning continuous-time global convergence gradient projection piecewise-polynomial

简要说明：本文提出 GlobMP，一种具有全局收敛保证的连续时间运动规划与引导算法，将约束视为分段多项式曲线上的多项式，并在多机器人、迷宫及人形引导任务中展示了优越性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces GlobMP, a continuous-time motion planning and steering algorithm with provable global convergence, treating constraints as polynomials over piecewise-polynomial curves and demonstrating superior performance across multi-robot, maze, and humanoid steering tasks.

Abstract: Motion planning is central to robotics, and it is increasingly used to correct the motions proposed by learned planners and policies. In both uses, constraints must hold at every instant of the motion, not only at sampled times. To our knowledge, no algorithm provably converges to a globally optimal motion once a smoothness cost is combined with such constraints. We cast planning and steering as a single continuous-time program: robots avoid one another and static or moving obstacles, and a learned proposal is steered by keeping the motion close to it. The program is elementary to state, yet nonconvex. We propose GlobMP (Global Motion Planning), a gradient projection method over piecewise-polynomial curves, on which each constraint is one polynomial per piece that must stay nonnegative over the whole motion; it alternates cost reduction with feasibility restoration. Under mild assumptions, we show that, from a fine grid start, its cost approaches the global optimum as the number of polynomial pieces grows, with every constraint met to any chosen tolerance, or exactly on stable instances. We demonstrate its superior performance over strong baselines in real and synthetic experiments, including teams of up to $200$ robots, multi-robot planning on the Robotarium testbed and an extended benchmark, maze navigation, and steering tactile-reactive policies on a bimanual humanoid.

摘要（中文）：运动规划是机器人学的核心问题，并且越来越多地被用于修正由学习型规划器和策略所提出的运动。在这两类应用中，约束必须在运动的每一个瞬间都得到满足，而不仅仅是在采样时刻。据我们所知，当平滑度成本与这类约束相结合时，尚无算法能够被证明收敛到全局最优运动。我们将规划与引导统一为一个连续时间的优化问题：机器人之间相互避碰，同时避开静态或移动障碍物，而学习型提议运动则通过使实际运动与之保持接近来被引导。该问题表述简单，但却是非凸的。我们提出GlobMP（全局运动规划）方法，这是一种基于分段多项式曲线的梯度投影方法，在该方法中，每个约束在每一段上都对应一个多项式，且该多项式必须在整个运动期间保持非负；该方法在降低成本与恢复可行性之间交替进行。在温和假设下，我们证明了从足够细的网格起点出发，随着多项式段数的增加，其成本趋近于全局最优值，并且所有约束都能满足任意指定的容差，或在稳定实例上得到精确满足。我们在真实与合成实验中展示了其相较于强基线方法的优越性能，包括多达$200$个机器人的编队、Robotarium测试平台上的多机器人规划及其扩展基准测试、迷宫导航，以及双臂人形机器人上的触觉反应策略引导。

Authors: Mohsen Amiri, Sima Didari, Davoud Ataee Tarzanagh, Hankyu Moon, Yeongdae Kwon

PATH: Preference-Aware Traversability Estimation for Robotic Teleoperation in Off-Road Navigation Other

traversability estimation off-road teleoperation inverse reinforcement learning speed recommendation preference-conditioned

简要说明：PATH-Net 是一种面向越野遥操作、考虑操作者偏好的可通行性估计框架，通过分层多头网络结合逆强化学习生成偏好条件下的成本图与速度建议。15名操作员的实验表明，轨迹对齐改善且工作负担降低。

TLDR: PATH-Net is a preference-aware traversability estimation framework for off-road teleoperation, generating cost maps and speed recommendations conditioned on operator preferences via a hierarchical multi-head network trained with inverse reinforcement learning. User studies with 15 operators show improved trajectory alignment and reduced workload.

Abstract: Traversability estimation is critical for ground vehicle teleoperation, yet existing methods often neglect the human operator's preferences for speed and risk tolerance. To address this gap, we propose PATH-Net, a Preference-Aware Traversability estimation Hierarchical Network that adaptively generates preference-conditioned traversability cost maps and speed profiles for off-road teleoperation. Our framework integrates visual and geometric bird's-eye-view features with short-term historical vehicle states through a multi-head shared-backbone architecture. Our PATH-Net infers traversability cost maps while optimizing speed recommendations by using maximum entropy inverse reinforcement learning and sparse speed supervision. Our method incorporates operator preference via an asymmetric feature aggregation mechanism, splitting inference into a cost branch that prioritizes high-risk traversability regions and a speed branch that outputs preference-adjusted recommended speeds. Experiments with 15 operators across 225 teleoperated trajectories show alignment with user-specific navigation strategies, achieving modified Hausdorff distance of 0.17 m (aggressive) and 0.15 m (conservative). In the questionnaire assessment, participants reported lower NASA-TLX workload scores with PATH-Net recommendations than without recommendations, decreasing from 34.7 to 22.2. These results support preference-conditioned trajectory and speed recommendation for off-road teleoperation.

摘要（中文）：可通行性估计对地面车辆遥操作至关重要，然而现有方法往往忽略了操作员对速度和风险容忍度的偏好。为弥补这一不足，我们提出PATH-Net，一种偏好感知的可通行性估计层次化网络，能够自适应地为越野遥操作生成偏好条件下的可通行性代价地图和速度剖面。我们的框架通过多头共享主干架构，将视觉与几何鸟瞰特征同短期历史车辆状态相融合。PATH-Net利用最大熵逆强化学习和稀疏速度监督，在推断可通行性代价地图的同时优化速度建议。该方法通过非对称特征聚合机制融入操作员偏好，将推断过程分为两个分支：代价分支优先关注高风险可通行性区域，速度分支则输出经偏好调整的建议速度。基于15名操作员、225条遥操作轨迹的实验表明，该方法与用户特定的导航策略高度一致，改进后的豪斯多夫距离分别为0.17米（激进型）和0.15米（保守型）。在问卷评估中，参与者在PATH-Net建议下的NASA-TLX工作负荷评分低于无建议条件，从34.7降至22.2。上述结果支持偏好条件下的轨迹与速度建议在越野遥操作中的应用。

Authors: Xianghao Meng, Wenshuo Wang, Cheng Shao, Lewei Feng, Qingxiao Liu, Canyu Wang, Junqiang Xi

OASIS: Online Anchor-centric Scene Inference System for Open-Vocabulary Retrieval and Navigation in Dynamic Environments VLN

online mapping open-vocabulary retrieval navigation dynamic environments anchor-centric representation

简要说明：OASIS 是一个统一的在线建图与导航系统，利用带有多种模态表示的稀疏锚点节点，在动态室内环境中实现高效开放词汇检索和移动物体的重定位。

TLDR: OASIS is a unified online mapping and navigation system that uses a sparse set of anchor nodes with multimodal representations to achieve efficient open-vocabulary retrieval and relocalization of moved objects in dynamic indoor environments.

Abstract: Reliable robotic mapping in dynamic real-world environments is essential for embodied intelligence and long-term autonomy. However, existing methods often involve a trade-off: lightweight online mapping is efficient but captures limited semantic context, while dense mapping provides richer semantics at higher computational cost and is more vulnerable to distractors. They also struggle to relocalize objects after scene changes. To address these challenges, we propose the Online Anchor-centric Scene Inference System (OASIS), a unified system for online mapping, complex open-vocabulary retrieval, and navigation in dynamic environments. Motivated by the observation that indoor scenes are organized around stable semantic anchors, OASIS represents the environment using a sparse set of anchor nodes, each maintaining a unified multimodal representation that integrates semantic descriptions, visual features, and geometric states for reasoning, verification, and navigation. Its compact anchor-centric memory supports on-demand evidence extraction and hierarchical retrieval, reducing redundant storage while improving retrieval reliability. To handle scene dynamics, OASIS further reuses transient observations collected during navigation to relocalize moved objects. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments, including standard retrieval benchmarks and navigation tasks under both static and dynamic settings, demonstrate that our system can perform complex open-vocabulary retrieval and navigation, while also enabling relocation of displaced objects after scene changes.

摘要（中文）：在动态真实环境中进行可靠的机器人建图，对于具身智能和长期自主性至关重要。然而，现有方法往往面临权衡：轻量级在线建图效率高，但捕获的语义上下文有限；而稠密建图虽能提供更丰富的语义信息，却计算成本更高，且更容易受干扰因素影响。此外，这些方法在场景变化后重新定位物体方面也存在困难。为解决上述挑战，我们提出了在线锚点中心场景推断系统（OASIS），一个用于动态环境中在线建图、复杂开放词汇检索和导航的统一系统。受室内场景围绕稳定语义锚点组织的观察启发，OASIS使用一组稀疏的锚点节点来表示环境，每个节点维护一个统一的多模态表示，融合语义描述、视觉特征和几何状态，以支持推理、验证和导航。其紧凑的锚点中心内存支持按需证据提取和分层检索，在减少冗余存储的同时提高检索可靠性。为处理场景动态性，OASIS进一步利用导航过程中收集的瞬态观测来重新定位移动物体。在仿真和真实环境中的实验，包括标准检索基准以及静态和动态条件下的导航任务，均证明我们的系统能够执行复杂的开放词汇检索和导航，同时也能在场景变化后实现移位物体的重新定位。

Authors: Kaiyao Liao, Qingfeng Li, Chen Chen, Xiaoze Wu, Qing Sun, Jianwei Niu

Decision Making and Ride Comfort Evaluation Based on Lane-Change Prediction for Autonomous Vehicles AutonomousDriving

lane-change prediction knowledge graph embeddings Bayesian inference autonomous vehicle decision-making ride comfort

简要说明：本文将基于知识图谱嵌入和贝叶斯推断的车道变换预测集成到自动驾驶决策中，在CARLA模拟中评估三种驾驶策略，结果表明预测策略能够避免碰撞并降低峰值减速度，并通过ISO 2631-1评估乘坐舒适性。

TLDR: This paper integrates lane-change prediction based on knowledge graph embeddings and Bayesian inference into autonomous vehicle decision-making, evaluating three driving strategies in CARLA simulations to show that predictive strategies avoid collisions and reduce peak deceleration, with ride comfort assessed via ISO 2631-1.

Abstract: Predicting surrounding vehicles' lane-change intentions enables autonomous vehicles to anticipate potential hazards and respond proactively rather than relying solely on reactive maneuvers. This study investigates the benefits of integrating lane-change prediction, based on knowledge graph embeddings and Bayesian inference, into autonomous vehicle decision-making. Three driving strategies are evaluated in risky merging scenarios simulated in CARLA: reactive driving, prediction-based longitudinal action, and prediction-based lateral action. The proposed prediction model anticipates the surrounding vehicle's lane change approximately 3-4 seconds before its occurrence, allowing the ego vehicle to adjust its behavior accordingly. In the representative simulation records, reactive driving results in a collision accompanied by aggressive deceleration. In contrast, prediction-based longitudinal action initiates early braking to establish a safe gap, while prediction-based lateral action performs a lane change when a safe adjacent lane is available. Both predictive strategies avoid collisions in the evaluated records. Compared with reactive driving, peak deceleration before impact is reduced by 31.5% with longitudinal action and 91.0% with lateral action. Additionally, an ISO 2631-1-based horizontal vibration estimate is used to provide a ride comfort assessment. Overall, the results highlight the potential of lane-change prediction to support safer and smoother driving through proactive decision-making, with additional insights into ride comfort provided by vibration-based estimates.

摘要（中文）：预测周围车辆的变道意图能使自动驾驶汽车提前预判潜在危险并主动响应，而非仅依赖被动应对操作。本研究探讨了将基于知识图谱嵌入和贝叶斯推断的变道预测融入自动驾驶汽车决策所带来的优势。在CARLA模拟的危险汇入场景中，评估了三种驾驶策略：反应式驾驶、基于预测的纵向操作和基于预测的横向操作。所提出的预测模型能在周围车辆变道前约3至4秒预判其意图，使自车能够相应调整行为。在代表性仿真记录中，反应式驾驶导致碰撞并伴随剧烈减速。相比之下，基于预测的纵向操作会提前制动以建立安全间距，而基于预测的横向操作则在相邻车道安全可用时执行变道。两种预测策略在所评估的记录中均避免了碰撞。与反应式驾驶相比，纵向操作使碰撞前峰值减速度降低31.5%，横向操作则降低91.0%。此外，采用基于ISO 2631-1的横向振动估计来提供乘坐舒适性评估。总体而言，研究结果凸显了变道预测在通过主动决策支持更安全、更平顺驾驶方面的潜力，同时基于振动的估计为乘坐舒适性提供了额外见解。

Authors: Mohamed Manzour, Aditya Kumar, Rubén Izquierdo, Miguel Ángel Sotelo

PhysibleMDM: Enforcing Inference-Time Physical Feasibility Constraints on Motion Diffusion Models via Noise Optimization HumanoidEmbodied

Motion Diffusion Models Inference-Time Optimization Physical Feasibility Sep-CMA-ES Inverse Dynamics

简要说明：PhysibleMDM 通过噪声优化和替代运动/动态约束，在推理时强化运动扩散模型输出的物理可行性，无需重新训练即可显著减少地面穿透、滑移和自碰撞。

TLDR: PhysibleMDM enforces physical feasibility constraints on motion diffusion model outputs at inference time via noise optimization with Sep-CMA-ES and surrogate kinematic/dynamic checks, reducing ground penetration, slip, and self-collision without retraining.

Abstract: Motion Diffusion Models (MDMs) can generate diverse and visually appealing human motion; yet, the resulting trajectories frequently violate physical constraints, limiting their downstream use in simulation and control. We present PhysibleMDM, a framework that promotes physical feasibility of MDM output by optimizing at inference time the diffusion noise without retraining the generative model. We introduce a set of surrogate feasibility constraints that can be evaluated without full trajectory simulation. These constraints combine kinematic checks (e.g., ground penetration, slip, and self-collision) with dynamic feasibility tests computed via an inverse-dynamics inner loop formulated as a cone program. We solve the resulting black-box noise optimization problem using the Separable Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (Sep-CMA-ES), thereby avoiding reliance on computationally expensive and discontinuous gradients. An autoregressive scheme then chains optimized segments to synthesize long motion sequences. Across 100 motion styles on an SMPL humanoid, PhysibleMDM reduces mean ground penetration, self-collision penetration, and ground slip by 75%, 92%, and 74%, respectively, relative to unoptimized diffusion output. Across 11 sequences for a custom bipedal robot, it achieves median reductions of 89.5% in per-sequence mean acceleration-reconstruction error and 79.5% in the mean inverse-dynamics residual.

摘要（中文）：运动扩散模型（MDMs）能够生成多样且视觉上吸引人的虚拟人体运动，然而，其生成的轨迹常常违反物理约束，限制了它们在仿真和控制中的进一步应用。我们提出了PhysibleMDM框架，通过在推理阶段优化扩散噪声而不重新训练生成模型，来提升MDM输出的物理可行性。我们引入了一组无需完整轨迹仿真即可评估的替代可行约束。这些约束结合了运动学检查（如地面穿透、滑动和自碰撞）与通过逆动力学内循环计算得出的动力学可行性测试，该内循环被表述为一个锥规划问题。我们使用可分离协方差矩阵自适应进化策略（Sep-CMA-ES）来解决由此产生的黑箱噪声优化问题，从而避免依赖计算成本高昂且不连续的梯度。随后，一种自回归方案将优化后的片段串联起来，以合成较长的运动序列。在SMPL人体模型上涵盖100种运动风格的情况下，与未优化的扩散输出相比，PhysibleMDM将平均地面穿透、自碰撞穿透和地面滑动分别降低了75%、92%和74%。针对定制双足机器人的11个序列，它在每序列平均加速度重建误差上实现了89.5%的中位降幅，在平均逆动力学残差上实现了79.5%的中位降幅。

Authors: Maximilian Stölzle, David Müller, Agon Serifi, Ruben Grandia, Espen Knoop, Moritz Bächer

Externalise the Memory: A Pre-Registered Study of Where an Embodied Agent's Experience Should Live VLA

memory-augmented retrieval buffer LoRA distillation vision-conditioned reach task embodied agent

简要说明：本文预先注册并测试了具身智能体的记忆应存储在权重中还是外部检索中，发现在视觉条件下的到达任务中，外部检索显著优于权重蒸馏。

TLDR: This paper pre-registers and tests whether an embodied agent's memory should be in weights or external retrieval, finding that external retrieval significantly boosts performance over weight distillation on a vision-conditioned reach task.

Abstract: Should an embodied agent's experience be baked into its policy weights, or kept external and retrieved at inference? A memory-augmented teacher (a VLM that retrieves lessons, with their episode images, from its own past attempts) produces trajectories on a vision-conditioned reach task; from the same trajectories we distil LoRA student policies and evaluate them under matched protocols, including one that re-attaches the teacher's frozen retrieval buffer to a fixed set of student weights. We pre-registered the hypotheses, arms, tests, and analysis rules before training and before any p-value. Distilling the memory-augmented behaviour into weights beat an action-only control by +1 pp (n.s.); the registered test proves underpowered for its own minimum effect, so we withdraw - rather than refute - the memory-in-weights claim. Attaching retrieval to a fixed set of student weights added +34 pp (z=5.15), reaching the pooled memory-augmented teacher reference (49.3%); the pre-registered protocol contrast agrees (+23 pp, z=3.36); under a pre-registered auto-reset sensitivity count the two are +36 and +29 pp. An exploratory behavioural probe with pre-registered per-arm predictions is consistent with behavioural distillation transferring the marginal correction but not the conditional, situation-specific correction that retrieval supplies. The recipe that follows is to externalise the memory: in follow-up controls registered before they ran, the same frozen buffer lifts the base model with no adapter to 48% (sensitivity 48%) and the other three adapters from 19-26% to 53-55% (sensitivity 17-21% to 50-55%), and the adapter adds nothing detectable once the buffer is attached. On a second, harder task, the retrieval advantage points the same direction but falls short of significance (+6 pp, 95% CI [-4.5, +16.4]); exploratory diagnostics tie the attenuation to memory coverage.

摘要（中文）：一个具身智能体的经验，是应当被固化到其策略权重之中，还是在推理时保持外部化并进行检索？一个具备记忆增强能力的教师模型——即一个能够从其自身过往尝试中检索经验教训及其片段图像、并进行视觉条件化操作的视觉语言模型——在视觉条件化伸手任务中生成了行为轨迹；我们基于这些轨迹蒸馏出低秩适配的学生策略，并在匹配的协议条件下对其进行评估，其中一种协议是将教师的冻结检索缓冲区重新附加到一组固定的学生权重上。我们在训练开始前以及任何p值产生前，预先注册了假设、实验组、检验方法和分析规则。将记忆增强行为蒸馏进权重的做法，相较于仅基于动作的对照组提升了+1个百分点（不显著）；注册检验在其自身最小效应量下统计功效不足，因此我们对“记忆存在于权重中”这一主张予以撤回，而非反驳。将检索附加到固定的学生权重上带来了+34个百分点的提升（z=5.15），达到了汇总后的记忆增强教师参考水平（49.3%）；预先注册的协议对比结果与此一致（+23个百分点，z=3.36）；在预先注册的自动重置敏感性计数下，两者分别为+36和+29个百分点。一项探索性行为探测实验，结合预先注册的各实验组预测，其结果与以下观点一致：行为蒸馏迁移了边际修正，但未能迁移检索所提供的条件性、情境特异的修正。由此得出的方案是：将记忆外部化——在运行前注册的后续对照组中，相同的冻结缓冲区将无适配器的基座模型提升至48%（敏感性为48%），并将另外三种适配器从19-26%提升至53-55%（敏感性从17-21%提升至50-55%）；而一旦缓冲区被附加，适配器并未带来任何可检测的额外增益。在第二个难度更高的任务上，检索优势方向一致，但未达到显著性水平（+6个百分点，95%置信区间为[-4.5, +16.4]）；探索性诊断将这种衰减归因于记忆覆盖率。

Authors: Cheng-Yin Tu

Tactile-Based Robotic Manipulation: From Mechanics-Driven to Data-Driven Perspectives Manipulation

tactile sensing robotic manipulation data-driven policy learning vision-language-action models contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：本文回顾了基于触觉的机器人操作领域，对比了通过力学模型解释物理接触的机理驱动方法与直接从数据中学习的数据驱动方法，并涵盖了包括VLA和预测模型在内的最新进展。

TLDR: This paper reviews the field of tactile-based robotic manipulation, contrasting mechanics-driven approaches that interpret physical contact through models with data-driven approaches that learn from data, and covers recent advances including VLA and predictive models.

Abstract: Tactile sensing provides robots with direct access to physical interactions at the contact interface, making it a critical modality for robust and dexterous manipulation. Over the past several decades, tactile-based manipulation research has evolved from mechanics-driven approaches, which explicitly interpret tactile signals through contact mechanics and task-specific reasoning, to data-driven approaches that learn tactile representations and manipulation policies directly from data. This paper reviews the development of tactile-based manipulation from these two complementary perspectives. We first introduce the fundamentals of tactile sensing, and then review, from a mechanics-driven perspective, how those signals form manipulation-relevant state representations and subsequently influence the robot action. We then examine the recent advances in data-driven tactile manipulation, covering imitation learning, reinforcement learning, vision-language-action models, and predictive models. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future opportunities toward scalable, generalizable, and robust tactile-enabled robotic systems.

摘要（中文）：触觉感知使机器人能够在接触界面直接获取物理交互信息，因此成为实现稳健和灵巧操作的关键感知模态。在过去几十年中，基于触觉的操作研究经历了从力学驱动方法到数据驱动方法的演变：前者通过接触力学和任务特定推理显式地解释触觉信号，后者则直接从数据中学习触觉表征和操作策略。本文从这两个互补的视角综述了基于触觉的操作研究的发展。我们首先介绍触觉传感的基本原理，然后从力学驱动的角度回顾触觉信号如何形成与操作相关的状态表征，并进而影响机器人的动作决策。随后，我们考察了数据驱动触觉操作的最新进展，涵盖模仿学习、强化学习、视觉-语言-动作模型以及预测模型。最后，我们讨论了实现可扩展、可泛化且稳健的触觉赋能机器人系统所面临的开放挑战和未来机遇。

Authors: Jingyi Xiang, Yixuan Wang, Wenzhen Yuan

MPBRS: Multi-Potential-Based Reward Shaping for Unified Reward Configuration in Humanoid Locomotion Locomotion

reward shaping humanoid locomotion reinforcement learning potential-based reward multi-robot

简要说明：本文提出基于多势能的奖励塑形（MPBRS），统一人形机器人的奖励配置，在多个机器人上降低调参敏感性并保持策略最优性不受影响。

TLDR: This paper proposes Multi-Potential-Based Reward Shaping (MPBRS) to unify reward configuration for humanoid locomotion across multiple robots, demonstrating reduced tuning sensitivity and consistent scaling without altering the optimal policy.

Abstract: Designing and tuning reward functions remains one of the main challenges in building effective reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for humanoid locomotion. While shaping rewards can accelerate learning, naively formulated terms often conflict with the desired behavior, overfit to a specific robot, or become unstable under small weight changes. Potential-Based Reward Shaping (PBRS) offers an alternative solution: shaping the reward via differences of a potential function to guide exploration without changing the optimal policy. In this paper, we study Multi-PBRS for humanoid locomotion and propose a unified reward configuration. We then evaluate the same reward structure and weights across nine humanoid robots, requiring only robot-specific metadata (joint/link mappings and default poses) rather than per-robot reward redesign. Our experiments show that, compared to standard shaping, MPBRS provides more consistent scaling behavior and reduced tuning sensitivity across robots, making it easier to tune without altering the optimal policy.

摘要（中文）：设计与调优奖励函数仍然是构建有效的人形机器人运动强化学习（RL）流程中的主要挑战之一。虽然塑造奖励可以加速学习，但简单设计的项往往与期望行为相冲突，过度拟合特定机器人，或在权重微小变化时变得不稳定。基于势能的奖励塑形（PBRS）提供了一种替代方案：通过势能函数的差分来塑造奖励，从而引导探索，同时不改变最优策略。本文研究了多势能奖励塑形（Multi-PBRS）在人形机器人运动中的应用，并提出了一种统一的奖励配置。随后，我们在九种不同的人形机器人上评估了相同的奖励结构和权重，仅需特定于机器人的元数据（关节/连杆映射和默认姿态），而无需针对每个机器人重新设计奖励。实验结果表明，与标准塑形方法相比，MPBRS在跨机器人上表现出更一致的扩展行为和更低的调参敏感性，使得调参更加容易，同时不改变最优策略。

Authors: Van Chung Nguyen, Hung Manh La

An Introduction to World Models for Generalist Agents WorldModel

world models generalist agents POMDP reinforcement learning model-based control

简要说明：本文为通用智能体的世界模型提供了统一的概念性介绍，将其置于POMDP、控制和强化学习框架下，并探讨了如何通过条件预测将世界模型与策略学习统一起来。

TLDR: This paper presents a unified conceptual introduction to world models for generalist agents, framing them within POMDP, control, and RL, and discussing how they can be unified with policy learning through conditional prediction.

Abstract: World models have recently emerged as a promising direction toward developing generalist agents capable of understanding, predicting, and interacting with diverse environments. However, despite growing interest, the concept of a world model remains loosely defined, encompassing approaches ranging from predictive dynamics models and learned simulators to models that jointly generate future observations and actions. This introductory paper aims to clarify the concept of world models and provide a unified perspective on their role in developing generalist agents. Starting from the partially observable Markov decision process (POMDP) framework, we connect world modeling to classical control, dynamical systems, signal processing, and reinforcement learning. We introduce different approaches to world modeling, emphasizing the knowledge they capture, their learning objectives, and how they support decision-making. We further explore the relationship between world modeling and policy learning, highlighting how these capabilities can be unified through conditional prediction without requiring separate models. Rather than offering an exhaustive survey of existing methods, this paper focuses on fundamental concepts, modeling principles, and connections, with the goal of providing an accessible and unified introduction to world models for generalist agents.

摘要（中文）：世界模型近来已成为一个颇具前景的研究方向，旨在开发能够理解、预测并与多样化环境互动的通用智能体。然而，尽管关注度与日俱增，世界模型这一概念的定义仍较为宽泛，涵盖了从预测性动力学模型、学习型模拟器，到联合生成未来观测与动作的模型等多种方法。本文作为引言性论文，旨在厘清世界模型的概念，并为其在开发通用智能体中的作用提供统一视角。我们从部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP）框架出发，将世界建模与经典控制、动力系统、信号处理及强化学习联系起来。我们介绍了世界建模的不同方法，重点强调其所捕获的知识、学习目标以及如何支撑决策制定。我们进一步探讨了世界建模与策略学习之间的关系，指出这两者可以通过条件预测加以统一，而无需分别建立独立模型。本文并非对现有方法的详尽综述，而是聚焦于基本概念、建模原理及其相互联系，旨在为通用智能体的世界模型提供一个易于理解且统一的入门介绍。

Authors: Zhihui Zhu

Asking Less, Adapting Better: Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation for Vision-and-Language Navigation VLN

Test-Time Adaptation Vision-and-Language Navigation feedback efficiency entropy-gradient saliency human feedback

简要说明：本文提出 FETA，一种用于视觉语言导航的反馈高效测试时自适应方法，通过分层样本选择和熵梯度显著性来定位关键动作，并通过差异感知熵优化减少人工干预并提升性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces FETA, a feedback-efficient test-time adaptation method for Vision-and-Language Navigation that localizes informative samples and actions via hierarchical selection and entropy-gradient saliency, then applies discrepancy-aware entropy optimization to improve adaptation with fewer human interventions.

Abstract: Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) requires agents to follow instructions and navigate to target locations. However, current VLN agents often suffer severe performance degradation in unseen environments due to distribution shifts. Test-Time Adaptation (TTA) offers a promising paradigm to bridge this gap, yet existing methods that rely on unsupervised entropy minimization can propagate errors through the trajectory, causing cascading failures in navigation. Recent methods mitigate this by incorporating human feedback, but they apply trajectory-level supervision uniformly across all steps without localizing the actions is truly informative, leading to inefficient feedback utilization and mismatched optimization granularity. To address these limitations, we propose FETA, a Feedback-Efficient Test-Time Adaptation method that improves both feedback efficiency and optimization reliability. To reduce unnecessary human interventions, we introduce a hierarchical sample selection strategy to localize informative samples. Specifically, we first filter trajectories whose normalized policy entropy exhibits large fluctuations. Within each selected trajectory, we further select the critical action via an entropy-gradient saliency criterion and query a single binary feedback on its correctness. A discrepancy-aware entropy optimization objective then updates the policy only at the queried step, with adaptive scaling that assigns larger relative weights to samples with greater prediction-feedback discrepancy. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that FETA achieves state-of-the-art performance with fewer human interventions, while remaining robust under noisy feedback and continual adaptation settings.

摘要（中文）：视觉与语言导航（VLN）要求智能体遵循指令并导航至目标位置。然而，由于分布偏移，当前的VLN智能体在未见环境中常常遭受严重的性能下降。测试时自适应（TTA）为弥合这一差距提供了一种有前景的范式，但现有依赖无监督熵最小化的方法可能通过轨迹传播误差，导致导航中的级联失败。近期方法通过引入人类反馈来缓解这一问题，但它们对所有步骤统一施加轨迹级监督，而未定位真正具有信息量的动作，导致反馈利用效率低下且优化粒度不匹配。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了FETA，一种反馈高效的测试时自适应方法，同时提升反馈效率和优化可靠性。为减少不必要的人工干预，我们引入了一种分层样本选择策略来定位具有信息量的样本。具体而言，我们首先筛选出归一化策略熵表现出大幅波动的轨迹。在每条选定的轨迹中，我们进一步通过熵梯度显著性准则选择关键动作，并仅对其正确性查询一次二元反馈。随后，一种差异感知的熵优化目标仅在查询步骤更新策略，并通过自适应缩放为预测与反馈差异较大的样本分配更大的相对权重。在多个基准上的大量实验表明，FETA以更少的人工干预取得了最先进的性能，同时在噪声反馈和持续自适应设置下保持鲁棒性。

Authors: Zixu Wang, Huaquan Zhang, Shoukai Xu, Jinwu Hu, Zhiquan Wen, Mingkui Tan

Reading, Writing, Sharing, and Interacting with the World through Video WorldModel

video world models video foundation models world modeling action-conditioned prediction interactive video

简要说明：该综述以世界建模为统一视角，将视频基础模型与世界模型联系起来，通过阅读、写作、共享和交互四个操作组织文献，总结了进展与开放挑战。

TLDR: This survey unifies video foundation models and world models under a world-modeling lens, organizing literature into reading, writing, sharing, and interacting with video to characterize progress and open challenges.

Abstract: Video foundation models have advanced rapidly in understanding and generating visual sequences, while video world models seek to capture the underlying dynamics of the world they depict. Despite their different objectives, both concern the relationship between video observations and an evolving world. This survey adopts world modeling as a unifying lens for examining these developments. Viewing an observed video as a partial, lossy, and temporally ordered projection of a latent temporal world, we organize the literature around four complementary operations: reading infers world properties from observed video; writing synthesizes video from specified or learned world conditions; sharing integrates understanding and generation through common modeling mechanisms; and interacting predicts and updates world states under actions and evolving observations. This perspective distinguishes temporal coherence in observed or generated sequences from consistency in the underlying world state. Across tasks, representations, models, datasets, and benchmarks, we trace a shift in emphasis from clip-level recognition and perceptual fidelity toward persistent state, controllable evolution, physical and causal validity, and evaluation grounded in interaction and downstream decisions, and we distill the open challenges that follow.

摘要（中文）：视频基础模型在理解和生成视觉序列方面取得了飞速进展，而视频世界模型则旨在捕捉其所描绘世界的潜在动态。尽管两者的目标不同，但它们都关注视频观测与演化世界之间的关系。本综述以世界建模为统一视角，审视这些发展。将观测到的视频视为潜在时间世界的部分、有损且按时间顺序排列的投影，我们围绕四种互补操作组织文献：读取（reading）从观测视频中推断世界属性；写入（writing）根据指定或习得的世界条件合成视频；共享（sharing）通过共同的建模机制整合理解与生成；交互（interacting）在行动和不断演化的观测下预测并更新世界状态。这一视角区分了观测或生成序列中的时间连贯性与底层世界状态的一致性。跨任务、表示、模型、数据集和基准，我们追溯了重点从片段级识别和感知保真度向持久状态、可控演化、物理与因果有效性以及基于交互和下游决策的评估转变的过程，并提炼出随之而来的开放性挑战。

Authors: Shengqiong Wu, Meng Luo, Bobo Li, Ziwei Liu, Shuicheng Yan, Ming-Hsuan Yang, Philip Torr, Hao Fei

PiHand: Latent Hand-Object Interaction Priors for Physics-Based Policy Learning Manipulation

dexterous manipulation hand-object interaction physics-based policy learning VAE prior residual exploration

简要说明：PiHand 提出了一种基于物理的灵巧手物交互合成框架，通过将动作捕捉演示中的专家策略蒸馏为目标条件 VAE 先验，并利用有界潜空间探索，实现对未见物体和抓取、交接等任务的泛化。

TLDR: PiHand introduces a physics-based framework for dexterous hand-object interaction synthesis, which distills expert policies from mocap demonstrations into a goal-conditioned VAE prior and uses bounded latent exploration to generalize to unseen objects and tasks like catching and handover.

Abstract: Synthesizing physically grounded dexterous hand-object interactions is important for VR/AR, gaming, and robotics, yet remains challenging because subtle contact dynamics, diverse object geometries, and target trajectories must be jointly respected while maintaining natural grasps. Existing methods either track mocap trajectories with limited transfer to novel objects, or rely on hand-only generative priors that fail to capture coupled hand-object motion, sacrificing contact fidelity and sample efficiency. To tackle these challenges, we introduce PiHand, a Physically grounded Interaction-aware Hand motion synthesis framework. PiHand first trains expert policies that track mocap demonstrations in simulation, distills them into a unified hand-object interaction prior using a goal-conditioned VAE, and finally solve diverse dexterous manipulation tasks through bounded residual exploration in its latent space. With only a single reward and no complex curriculum training, this yields general tabletop manipulation policies that generalize to unseen objects and trajectories on GRAB and DexYCB. The same prior transfers to object catching and bimanual handover, two tasks that are rarely seen in its training data. Across all tasks, PiHand consistently outperforms baselines in all metrics. We will release the processed data and model checkpoints.

摘要（中文）：摘要：生成具有物理基础的灵巧手-物体交互对于虚拟现实/增强现实、游戏和机器人技术具有重要意义，但由于必须同时兼顾微妙的接触动力学、多样的物体几何形状和目标轨迹，同时保持自然的抓取姿态，这一任务仍然充满挑战。现有方法要么跟踪动捕轨迹但难以泛化到新物体，要么依赖仅基于手部的生成先验，无法捕捉手-物体耦合运动，从而牺牲了接触保真度和样本效率。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了PiHand，一种基于物理的交互感知手部运动合成框架。PiHand首先在仿真中训练跟踪动捕示范的专家策略，利用目标条件变分自编码器将其蒸馏为统一的手-物体交互先验，最后通过在其潜空间中进行有界残差探索来解决多样的灵巧操作任务。仅使用单一奖励函数且无需复杂的课程训练，该方法便能生成通用的桌面操作策略，可泛化到GRAB和DexYCB数据集上的未见物体和轨迹。该先验还可迁移至物体抓接和双手交接任务，这两项任务在训练数据中极为罕见。在所有任务中，PiHand在所有指标上均持续优于基线方法。我们将发布处理后的数据和模型检查点。

Authors: Niklas Berndt, Xianghui Xie, Enes Duran, Yixiao Wang, Gerard Pons-Moll

RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation Perception3D

LiDAR semantic segmentation projection-based fusion ray-aligned encoding scan-topology-aware Mamba autonomous driving

简要说明：RaSFNet通过引入射线对齐的几何分布编码、扫描拓扑感知的Mamba模块和范围约束的点-视锥融合，提升了用于自动驾驶和机器人的LiDAR语义分割性能，在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes上达到先进水平。

TLDR: RaSFNet improves LiDAR semantic segmentation for autonomous driving/robotics by introducing ray-aligned geometric distribution encoding, scan-topology-aware Mamba blocks, and range-constrained point-frustum fusion, achieving state-of-the-art mIoU on SemanticKITTI and nuScenes.

Abstract: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.

摘要（中文）：激光雷达点云语义分割是自动驾驶和机器人技术中三维感知的基础组成部分。基于投影的方法将三维点云映射为二维表示，并利用二维网络进行特征提取。然而，投影过程中多个点的聚合可能会模糊每个视锥体内的几何差异，而局部特征提取又限制了跨扫描区域空间关系的建模。此外，投影表示中的邻近性并不必然意味着三维空间中的邻近性，点特征与投影特征之间的交互可能会混合来自不同范围的特征，从而降低语义判别能力。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了射线对齐与扫描感知融合网络（RaSFNet），该网络将点云几何和激光雷达扫描特性融入基于投影的语义分割中。具体而言，射线对齐几何分布编码（RAGDE）模块利用射线对齐坐标系表征每个视锥体内的点分布。为建模空间上下文，扫描拓扑感知Mamba（STAM）模块按照激光雷达方位角采样模式组织视锥体特征，并捕获跨扫描区域的长距离依赖关系。此外，范围约束点-视锥体融合（RCPFF）机制利用共享范围信息引导点表示与视锥体表示之间的特征交换，同时保持空间对应关系。RaSFNet在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别实现了70.2%和77.7%的mIoU分数，表明其与所评估方法相比具有竞争力的分割性能。

Authors: Chuang Chen

KinoUAV: A Benchmark for Safe and Stable UAV Vision-Language Navigation with Kinodynamic Modeling VLN

UAV navigation vision-language navigation kinodynamic modeling safety distance trajectory generation

简要说明：KinoUAV 提出了一个用于无人机视觉语言导航的运动动力学基准和智能体，通过基于加速度的轨迹生成和方向自由空间距离标签来提高安全性和稳定性，在 Cruise-Seek 任务上优于现有方法。

TLDR: KinoUAV introduces a kinodynamic-aware benchmark and agent for UAV vision-language navigation, incorporating acceleration-based trajectory generation and directional free-space distance labels to improve safety and stability, outperforming existing methods on the Cruise-Seek task.

Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) have recently emerged as important remote sensing platforms, and UAV navigation has shown great potential in remote sensing applications. However, existing methods do not explicitly incorporate kinodynamic modeling or safety distances into trajectory generation, resulting in high absolute yaw rates, frequent collisions, and low navigation success rates, which limit safety and motion stability. To address this challenge, we introduce KinoUAV, a kinodynamic benchmark comprising a dataset and KinoUAV-Agent. First, we develop a hierarchical kinodynamic trajectory generation pipeline that drives UAV through acceleration actions. It uses waypoint chains from global planning and generates trajectories segment by segment under velocity, acceleration, and jerk constraints, reducing oscillations and improving trajectory stability. Furthermore, we introduce directional free-space distance (DFD) labels into the constructed dataset to describe the available clearance for safe motion decisions. The proposed KinoUAV-Agent predicts DFDs and uses them to generate safe actions, decoupling perception from action decision-making. This design enables autonomous obstacle avoidance and improves navigation safety. The benchmark incorporates the proposed Cruise-Seek task, in which the UAV first enters the target region and then searches for the target, reducing the difficulty of target search and improving navigation success. Experiments on KinoUAV show that KinoUAV-Agent outperforms existing methods, achieving the highest success rate while maintaining lower absolute yaw rates and collision rates. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of kinodynamic modeling for safe and stable UAV navigation.

摘要（中文）：无人机近年来已成为重要的遥感平台，无人机导航在遥感应用中展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有方法未将动力学建模或安全距离显式纳入轨迹生成过程，导致绝对偏航率过高、碰撞频繁以及导航成功率较低，限制了安全性和运动稳定性。针对这一挑战，我们提出了KinoUAV——一个包含数据集和KinoUAV-Agent的动力学基准平台。首先，我们开发了一种分层动力学轨迹生成流程，通过加速度动作驱动无人机飞行。该流程利用全局规划生成的航路点链，在速度、加速度和加加速度约束下逐段生成轨迹，从而减少振荡并提高轨迹稳定性。此外，我们在构建的数据集中引入了方向性自由空间距离（DFD）标签，用以描述安全运动决策的可用间隙。所提出的KinoUAV-Agent预测DFD并利用其生成安全动作，将感知与动作决策解耦。该设计实现了自主避障并提升了导航安全性。该基准平台融入了所提出的巡航-搜索任务，在该任务中，无人机首先进入目标区域，然后搜索目标，从而降低了目标搜索难度并提高了导航成功率。在KinoUAV上的实验表明，KinoUAV-Agent优于现有方法，在保持较低绝对偏航率和碰撞率的同时取得了最高的成功率。这些结果验证了动力学建模对于安全稳定无人机导航的有效性。
