Authors: Chenyao Yang, Peijin Wang, Yingchao Feng, Wenhui Diao

Dispersive Tree Agreements for Multi-Robot Coordination Other

multi-robot coordination decentralized planning differentially flat systems column generation receding horizon

简要说明：本文提出了 WarpWeaver，一种去中心化、实时的多机器人协调规划器，通过色散树搜索和列生成逼近联合最优，在仿真和硬件实验中减少了行驶时间并提高了成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces WarpWeaver, a decentralized, real-time multi-robot coordination planner that approaches joint optimality through dispersive tree search and column generation, demonstrating reduced travel time and improved success rates in simulations and hardware experiments.

Abstract: Multi-robot coordination of nonlinear systems is naturally formulated as joint-space optimal control subject to constraints over groups of robots. Existing methods that approach joint optimality remain largely centralized, offline, and confined to collision-free motion planning, while decentralized, real-time counterparts target safe navigation without pursuing the joint optimum. This paper develops a decentralized, real-time planner that approaches the joint optimum as an anytime process. We extend a recent single-robot framework that searches dispersive trees of forward-propagated commands for differentially flat systems to coordinate a multi-robot team near-optimally. We first show that the inter-robot coupling can be effectively replaced by some local constraints, under which locally grown dispersive trees contain a near-optimal agreement. It is this structure that the robots pursue by decentralized column generation, negotiating rents on the shared space that guide the search of each robot's tree. The negotiation settles on an agreement whose near-optimality is certified at quiescence. Our protocol, WarpWeaver, implements this negotiation as an asynchronous real-time loop over a receding horizon, and demonstrates effective closure to quiesced agreements even when real-time deadlines cut the negotiation short. In simulation, WarpWeaver reduces total travel time by up to 22% against centralized offline planners on the Dynobench suite and by up to 37% against a decentralized real-time baseline, and nearly doubles the success rate of a task-specific planner on graph connectivity. Hardware experiments on six robots planning onboard demonstrate real-world implementability.

摘要（中文）：非线性系统的多机器人协调问题，天然地可以表述为在机器人群体约束下的联合空间最优控制问题。现有方法若追求联合最优性，则大多局限于集中式、离线处理，且仅限于无碰撞运动规划；而分散式、实时的对应方法则侧重于安全导航，并不追求联合最优解。本文提出了一种分散式、实时的规划器，以任意时间过程的方式逼近联合最优解。我们将近期提出的、针对微分平坦系统进行前向传播命令分散树搜索的单机器人框架，扩展至近最优地协调多机器人团队。我们首先证明，机器人间的耦合可以被有效地替换为若干局部约束，在此约束下，局部生长的分散树能够包含一个近最优的一致性协议。正是这种结构，使得机器人能够通过分散列生成来追求该协议，就共享空间的“租金”进行协商，用以引导每台机器人树的搜索方向。协商最终达成一个在静止状态下经认证为近最优的一致性协议。我们的协议——WarpWeaver——将该协商实现为一个异步的实时循环，在滚动时域上运行，并且即使在实时截止时间导致协商提前终止的情况下，也能有效地收敛至静止协议。在仿真中，与集中式离线规划器在Dynobench测试集上的结果相比，WarpWeaver将总行程时间最多减少了22%；与分散式实时基线方法相比，最多减少了37%；并且在图连通性任务上，将特定任务规划器的成功率几乎提高了一倍。在六台机器人上进行的机载规划硬件实验，证明了其在现实世界中的可实现性。

Authors: Shashank A. Deshpande, Blake T. Edwards, Jonathan P. How

PhysTrace: Interpretable Temporal Evaluation of Physical Consistency in Video Generative Models WorldModel

physical consistency video generative models temporal localization MLLM IntPhys2

简要说明：PhysTrace 是一个无需训练的框架，利用MLLM生成的历史条件期望来时间定位并描述视频生成模型中的物理不一致性，并引入了带违反区间的IntPhys2-Timing。它用于评估扩散/流式视频模型轨迹上的物理一致性，揭示属性与噪声相关的违反模式。

TLDR: PhysTrace is a training-free framework that uses MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations to temporally localize and describe physical inconsistencies in video generative models, and introduces IntPhys2-Timing with violation intervals. It applies this to evaluate physical consistency in diffusion/flow-based video models along their trajectories, revealing attribute- and noise-dependent violation patterns.

Abstract: World action models increasingly rely on pretrained video models assumed to capture physical dynamics for prediction, planning, and action generation. Existing evaluations assess plausibility, probe representations, or measure predictive surprise, but rarely identify which history-conditioned physical expectations conflict with observations. We introduce PhysTrace, a training-free framework aligning MLLM-generated, history-conditioned expectations with observed video windows to temporally localize physical violations and provide interpretable descriptions without task-specific probes or classifiers. We also introduce IntPhys2-Timing, adding violation intervals to IntPhys2. PhysTrace achieves a Hit Rate of up to 70.7% across physical principles on IntPhys2-Timing and outperforms the compared methods in overall possible-impossible discrimination accuracy on IntPhys2. Applied to reconstructed videos along the trajectories of pretrained diffusion/flow-based video models, PhysTrace reveals attribute- and noise-dependent patterns in physical violation localization, enabling interpretable physical consistency analysis across timesteps.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型日益依赖预训练视频模型，这些模型被假定能够捕捉物理动态，以用于预测、规划和动作生成。现有评估方法主要检验生成内容的合理性、探测表征或衡量预测惊奇度，但很少识别出哪些基于历史条件的物理预期与观测结果相冲突。我们提出PhysTrace，一种无需训练即可运行的框架，将多模态大语言模型生成的、基于历史条件的预期与观测视频窗口对齐，从而在时间上定位物理违规事件，并提供可解释的描述，无需特定任务探针或分类器。我们还引入IntPhys2-Timing，在IntPhys2基础上增加了违规区间标注。PhysTrace在IntPhys2-Timing上各类物理原则的命中率最高达70.7%，并在IntPhys2整体可能/不可能判别准确率上优于对比方法。将其应用于预训练扩散/流式视频模型轨迹上的重建视频，PhysTrace揭示了物理违规定位中与属性和噪声相关的模式，从而支持跨时间步长的可解释物理一致性分析。

Authors: Taekoan Yoo, Wonkyung Jung, Kyunghun Kim, Kyeongbo Kong

GelSlim 5.0: Unifying Vision and Touch with a Single Fingertip Camera Other

vision-tactile sensing multimodal transformer pose estimation contact geometry fingertip sensor

简要说明：GelSlim 5.0 使用单个指尖相机同时获取视觉和触觉信息，并通过多模态融合变换器 (VisTacFusion) 提升物体位姿和接触几何估计的精度。

TLDR: GelSlim 5.0 introduces a fingertip sensor that uses a single camera to capture both visual and tactile data, combined via a multimodal transformer (VisTacFusion) for improved object pose and contact geometry estimation on real objects.

Abstract: Vision and touch provide complementary cues for object pose and local contact geometry, but external cameras are often occluded at the contact site. We present GelSlim 5.0, a fingertip sensor that acquires visual and tactile observations with one fixed camera and a continuous UV-responsive contact layer. By switching illumination, the camera sequentially acquires through-membrane visual images and contact-sensitive tactile images from a shared viewpoint, avoiding inter-camera extrinsic calibration. To combine these observations, we introduce VisTacFusion, a multimodal transformer with separate prediction paths for planar object pose and contact geometry. Asymmetric bottleneck fusion incorporates visual context while preserving tactile spatial features for depth and surface-normal estimation. Modality dropout enables inference with paired inputs or either modality alone. On real validation data from 12 known objects, paired inputs reduce depth MSE, angular error, and translation $L_1$ by 61.2%, 72.3%, and 61.3%, respectively, relative to tactile-only inference with the same model. Relative to visual-only inference, the corresponding reductions are 93.7%, 6.1%, and 8.6%.

摘要（中文）：视觉和触觉为物体姿态及局部接触几何提供互补线索，但外部摄像头在接触处常常被遮挡。我们提出了 GelSlim 5.0，一种指尖传感器，通过单个固定摄像头和连续的紫外响应接触层获取视觉与触觉观测。通过切换照明，传感器从共享视角依次获取透过薄膜的视觉图像和接触敏感的触觉图像，从而避免了摄像头间的外部标定。为融合这些观测，我们引入了 VisTacFusion，一种多模态 Transformer，具有分别用于平面物体姿态和接触几何的独立预测路径。非对称瓶颈融合在保留触觉空间特征用于深度和表面法向量估计的同时，融入了视觉上下文。模态丢弃机制使得模型能够在成对输入或仅单一模态输入下进行推理。在来自 12 个已知物体的真实验证数据上，相对于相同模型仅使用触觉推理，成对输入分别使深度 MSE、角度误差和位移 $L_1$ 降低了 61.2%、72.3% 和 61.3%；相对于仅使用视觉推理，对应的降低幅度分别为 93.7%、6.1% 和 8.6%。

Authors: Xiangdong Wang, I-Hsuan Huang, Xiaohao Xu, Xili Yi, Nima Fazeli, Xiaonan Huang

Tilt-Rotor Quadcopter with Learned Residual Control and Mode-Dependent State Estimation Other

tilt-rotor quadcopter residual control state estimation EKF behavioral cloning

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于仿真的倾转旋翼四旋翼飞行控制栈，结合级联PD控制器、模式相关EKF状态估计和学习式残差控制器以改善风扰动抑制能力。通过特权风信息的行为克隆训练，残差将稳态悬停误差降低了约49%。

TLDR: This paper presents a simulation-based flight control stack for a tilt-rotor quadcopter, integrating a cascaded PD controller, mode-dependent EKF state estimation, and a learned residual controller to improve wind disturbance rejection. The residual, trained via behavioral cloning with privileged wind information, reduces steady-state station-keeping error by approximately 49% in simulation.

Abstract: Tilt-rotor quadcopters redirect thrust for translation without banking, but complicate modeling, state estimation, and disturbance rejection. This paper presents a simulation-based flight stack for a \SI{2.00}{\kilo\gram} tilt-rotor quadcopter. The system uses a six-degree-of-freedom nonlinear model with first-order motor dynamics and two-axis rotor tilt, parameterized using a 3D CAD model. A cascaded PD controller commands forward and lateral tilt angles. A 14-state EKF fuses sensor data across hover, early-transition, and transition modes using a hysteretic (Schmitt-trigger) classifier to prevent covariance discontinuities. Because the proportional position loop leaves a steady-state offset under constant wind, a small bounded neural residual is added on top of the unmodified PD controller. It is trained by behavioral cloning from a teacher with privileged access to the true wind, while the deployed network never observes wind. In simulation, the EKF achieves a post-settling position root mean square error (RMSE) of \SI{0.226}{\metre} (horizontal) and \SI{0.03}{\metre} (vertical) and an attitude RMSE below \SI{0.8}{\degree}, and it estimates a wind velocity of $(\num{2.0}, \num{-1.2})\,\unit{\metre\per\second}$ to within \SI{0.15}{\metre\per\second} per axis. The residual reduces steady-state station-keeping error under wind by approximately \SI{49}{\percent}, from \SI{0.117}{\metre} to \SI{0.060}{\metre} at \SI{1.5}{\metre\per\second} and from \SI{0.319}{\metre} to \SI{0.162}{\metre} at an out-of-distribution \SI{3.9}{\metre\per\second}. The framework provides a basis for hardware-in-the-loop and flight-test studies.

摘要（中文）：倾转旋翼四旋翼飞行器通过改变推力方向来实现平移而无需倾斜机体，但这也使得建模、状态估计和扰动抑制变得更加复杂。本文针对一架重量为2.00千克的倾转旋翼四旋翼飞行器，提出了一套基于仿真的飞行控制系统。该系统采用六自由度非线性模型，包含一阶电机动力学和双轴旋翼倾转特性，并利用三维CAD模型进行参数化。级联PD控制器负责生成前向和侧向倾转角指令。一个14状态扩展卡尔曼滤波器（EKF）通过滞回（施密特触发器）分类器融合悬停、早期过渡和过渡模式的传感器数据，以避免协方差突变。由于比例位置环在恒定风扰下存在稳态偏移，本文在未经修改的PD控制器基础上叠加了一个小型有界神经网络残差项。该残差项通过行为克隆从能够获取真实风况信息的教师模型中训练得到，而实际部署的网络则无法观测风速。仿真结果表明，EKF在稳定后的位置均方根误差（RMSE）为水平方向0.226米、垂直方向0.03米，姿态RMSE低于0.8度，并能以每轴0.15米/秒的精度估计风速为(2.0, -1.2)米/秒。该残差项使风扰下的稳态定点误差降低了约49%，在1.5米/秒风速下从0.117米降至0.060米，在分布外的3.9米/秒风速下从0.319米降至0.162米。该框架为硬件在环仿真和飞行试验研究提供了基础。

Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion for Anticipating Navigation Retreat in Robotic Flexible Endoscopy Other

Multimodal fusion Progress-residual Robotic flexible endoscopy Retreat anticipation Causal model

简要说明：该论文提出了MPRF，一种因果多模态模型，通过融合电机指令、电磁跟踪和内窥镜视频以及进展残差表示来预测机器人柔性内窥镜操作中的退缩行为，在结肠体模研究中提高了AUPRC。

TLDR: The paper introduces MPRF, a causal multimodal model that anticipates operator retreat in robotic flexible endoscopy by fusing motor commands, EM tracking, and endoscopic video with a progress-residual representation, achieving improved AUPRC in a colon-phantom study.

Abstract: Flexible robotic endoscopes provide access through tortuous anatomy, where friction, deformation, and wall interaction separate commanded insertion from useful distal progress. Operators interpret this mismatch and retreat to recover a navigable configuration. Recognizing the approach to that decision requires relating motor intent to distal response and the local visual scene. We introduce Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion (MPRF), a causal model that anticipates operator retreat from commands, electromagnetic (EM) tracking, and endoscopic video. A nominal-progress model predicts the response expected in normal or successful navigation; a temporal predictor combines its EM residual with all three observed modalities. In a 150-episode colon-phantom collection, MPRF achieves 0.580 +/- 0.007 AUPRC across three seeds, compared with 0.511 for the strongest reduced-modality control. Complete multimodal histories provide the principal ranking advantage, while the residual adds an explicit intent-response representation with a small, uncertain increment over raw fusion. Analysis of frozen alarms relates warning timing to the behavioral label and explains the increase in event recall under a longer matching window. These results establish a basis for behavioral assistance during operator-controlled navigation.

摘要（中文）：柔性机器人内窥镜能够通过曲折的解剖结构进行介入，在此过程中，摩擦力、形变及管壁相互作用使得指令输入与远端有效推进之间产生偏差。操作者需识别这一偏差并后退，以恢复可导航的构型。识别该决策的临近点，需要将电机意图与远端响应及局部视觉场景相关联。我们提出了一种多模态进展-残差融合（MPRF）模型，这是一种因果模型，能够从操作指令、电磁（EM）跟踪及内窥镜视频中预判操作者的后退行为。其中，名义进展模型用于预测正常或成功导航中预期的响应；时间预测器则将其电磁残差与全部三种观测模态相结合。在包含150次结肠镜模拟实验的数据集中，MPRF在三个随机种子上取得了0.580 ± 0.007的AUPRC，而最强的降模态对照仅为0.511。完整的多模态历史数据提供了主要的排序优势，而残差则引入了一种明确的意图-响应表示，相较于原始融合，其增益虽小但存在不确定性。对冻结警报的分析将警报时机与行为标签联系起来，并解释了在较长匹配窗口下事件召回率提高的原因。这些结果为操作者控制导航过程中的行为辅助奠定了基础。

Authors: Chi Kit Ng, Tianchun Wu, Jiatan Sun, Yuming Sun, Jianru Zhang, Hongliang Ren

LAST-V2X: Language-Driven Adaptive Scenario Synthesis and Testing for Communication-Induced Failures in V2X Safety Applications AutonomousDriving

V2X safety testing LLM-driven scenario generation fault injection CARLA simulation communication-induced failures

简要说明：一个语言驱动的自适应框架，利用LLMs在CARLA中合成并测试V2X通信故障场景，通过匹配执行来区分通信引起的安全故障与交通相关的故障。

TLDR: A language-driven adaptive framework that uses LLMs to synthesize and test V2X communication failure scenarios in CARLA, distinguishing communication-induced safety failures from traffic-related ones via matched executions.

Abstract: Vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication enables connected vehicles to make safety-critical decisions, but delayed, missing, or incorrect information can compromise driving safety. Systematically testing such failures is challenging because traffic interactions, communication conditions, and application responses must be jointly configured to produce meaningful scenarios. This paper presents LAST-V2X, a language-driven, adaptive framework for automated scenario synthesis and safety testing of V2X applications. LAST-V2X leverages large language models (LLMs) to translate natural-language test descriptions into executable scenarios grounded in roadway geometry, V2X communication semantics, and vehicle behavior. The framework integrates physical traffic simulation with spatially aware communication modeling and message-level fault injection to evaluate how information degradation affects vehicle decisions. To establish whether an observed safety failure is caused by communication rather than the underlying traffic conditions, LAST-V2X employs matched executions under degraded and ground-truth information. Furthermore, an execution-guided refinement mechanism combines parameter search and LLM self-reflection to identify ineffective test configurations, improve scenario effectiveness, and produce minimal reproducible failure cases. Experiments across diverse CARLA environments and V2X safety applications demonstrate the framework's ability to generate reliable scenarios, distinguish communication-induced failures from unrelated safety violations, and substantially improve failure discovery through adaptive refinement. These results establish LAST-V2X as a systematic approach to language-driven, causally verified, and adaptive safety testing for connected vehicle systems.

摘要（中文）：车联网（V2X）通信使智能网联车辆能够做出安全关键的决策，但信息的延迟、丢失或错误可能危及行车安全。系统性地测试此类故障具有挑战性，因为必须联合配置交通交互、通信条件和应用响应，才能生成有意义的测试场景。本文提出了LAST-V2X，一个语言驱动、自适应的自动化场景生成与V2X应用安全测试框架。LAST-V2X利用大语言模型（LLMs）将自然语言测试描述转化为以道路几何、V2X通信语义和车辆行为为基础的可执行场景。该框架将物理交通仿真与空间感知的通信建模及消息级故障注入相结合，以评估信息退化如何影响车辆决策。为了确定观察到的安全故障是由通信引起还是由底层交通条件所致，LAST-V2X在退化信息和真实信息条件下采用配对执行的方式进行比较。此外，执行引导的细化机制结合了参数搜索与LLM自我反思，以识别无效的测试配置、提升场景有效性并生成最小可复现的故障用例。在多种CARLA环境和V2X安全应用上的实验表明，该框架能够生成可靠的测试场景，区分通信引发的故障与无关的安全违规，并通过自适应细化显著提升故障发现能力。这些结果确立了LAST-V2X作为面向智能网联车辆系统的语言驱动、因果验证且自适应安全测试的系统性方法。

Authors: Keshu Wu, Hao Zhang, Rui Gan, Pei Li, Jiwan Jiang, Yang Zhou

Causal Analysis of Failures of Cyber-Physical Systems with Continuous Inputs AutonomousDriving

actual causality distance-weighted responsibility failure explanation autonomous driving black-box neural controllers

简要说明：本文扩展了实际因果关系理论以处理网络物理系统中的连续输入，引入了距离加权责任和解释推导算法，并在自动驾驶模拟器中进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper extends actual causality theory to handle continuous inputs in cyber-physical systems, introducing distance-weighted responsibility and an explanation-derivation algorithm, evaluated in autonomous driving simulators with black-box neural controllers.

Abstract: Modern autonomous Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), such as self-driving cars, operate in increasingly complex environments while expected to maintain high reliability. The black-box nature of many of these systems makes it impossible to fully verify their behavior prior to deployment. When a failure occurs, it is important to analyze it to guide improvements to system robustness. A recent work introduced the novel concept of leveraging the framework of actual causality for CPS failure explanation. However, that work considered only a discrete, binary causal model that cannot capture continuous changes in system inputs. In this paper, we address these limitations by extending the actual causality framework with the notion of distance to account for the continuous characteristics of the system. Specifically, we introduce the novel concepts of distance-weighted actual cause and distance-weighted degree of responsibility, enabling causal influence to account for the magnitude of changes required to avoid a failure, rather than only its cardinality. While motivated by the continuous nature of CPSs, this constitutes a general extension of the theory of actual causality and enables more fine-grained analysis of continuous inputs in any causal model. Building on these notions, we present an efficient, practical, system-agnostic explanation-derivation algorithm that uses distance-weighted responsibility to guide the explanation search. We experimentally evaluate our approach across a number of environments from two autonomous-driving simulators with black-box neural controllers. The results show that the proposed extension provides more effective guidance than the current discrete approach.

摘要（中文）：现代自主网络物理系统，如自动驾驶汽车，在日益复杂的环境中运行，同时需保持高可靠性。这些系统大多具有黑盒特性，使得在部署前无法完全验证其行为。当故障发生时，对其进行深入分析以指导系统鲁棒性的改进显得尤为重要。近期有研究创新性地提出利用实际因果关系框架来解释网络物理系统的故障。然而，该研究仅考虑了离散的二元因果模型，无法捕捉系统输入中的连续变化。本文针对这些局限性，通过引入距离概念扩展实际因果关系框架，以体现系统的连续特性。具体而言，我们提出了距离加权实际原因和距离加权责任程度的新概念，使因果影响能够反映避免故障所需变化的幅度，而不仅仅是变化的数量。尽管这一扩展源于网络物理系统的连续性，但其构成对实际因果关系理论的一般性推广，使得任何因果模型中的连续输入分析更加精细化。基于这些概念，我们提出了一种高效、实用且与系统无关的解释推导算法，利用距离加权责任来指导解释搜索。我们在两个自动驾驶模拟器中的多个环境中，采用黑盒神经控制器进行了实验评估。结果表明，相较于现有离散方法，所提出的扩展提供了更有效的指导。

Authors: Tom Yaacov, David A. Kelly, Khen Elimelech, Hana Chockler

CMAR-search: Commonsense and Memory Augmented Reasoning for Object Search in Dynamic Interactive Environments Other

Functional 3D Scene Graph commonsense reasoning memory-augmented object search dynamic environments

简要说明：CMAR-search 通过常识与记忆构建功能性3D场景图，将环境组织为功能区域与关联容器，支持分层动作规划，在动态交互环境中实现高效目标搜索，并在仿真与真实场景中验证。

TLDR: CMAR-search introduces a Functional 3D Scene Graph that organizes environments into functional areas with associated containers using commonsense and memory, enabling hierarchical action planning for efficient object search in dynamic interactive environments, validated in simulation and real-world settings.

Abstract: Dynamic interactive object search in large-scale human environments presents substantial challenges for existing methods. Current scene representations like 3D Scene Graphs (3DSG) only provide coarse-grained spatial segmentation and cannot identify functional areas such as storage or leisure areas. Without functional area understanding, existing methods are constrained to exhaustive sequential exploration at large scales, resulting in inefficient search behaviors -- particularly in open-layout environments with numerous interactive objects such as drawers and cabinets. Moreover, these methods lack adaptability to environmental dynamics such as object relocations. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CMAR-search, a novel framework built upon Commonsense and Memory Augmented Reasoning (CMAR). Our approach leverages commonsense about area functionalities and aggregates environmental memory to construct a Functional 3D Scene Graph (F3DSG), which organizes the environment into functional areas with their associated containers. Through this structured representation, CMAR enables hierarchical action planning at both macro-area and micro-container levels, empowering the system to efficiently identify and inspect semantically relevant areas for effective object search. Notably, CMAR continuously integrates real-time perception, accumulated memory, and commonsense to dynamically relocalize objects in changing environments. Extensive experiments in simulation and real-world settings demonstrate that CMAR-search significantly surpasses state-of-the-art baselines in both success rate and search efficiency for object search in dynamic interactive environments.

摘要（中文）：在规模化的人类环境中进行动态交互式物体搜索，对现有方法构成了重大挑战。当前的场景表示方法，如三维场景图（3DSG），仅能提供粗粒度的空间划分，无法识别诸如储物区或休闲区等功能区域。由于缺乏功能区域理解，现有方法在大规模场景中只能进行穷举式顺序探索，导致搜索行为效率低下——尤其是在包含大量抽屉、橱柜等交互式物体的开放式布局环境中。此外，这些方法对物体被移动等环境动态变化缺乏适应性。为解决上述局限性，本文提出CMAR-search，一种基于常识与记忆增强推理（CMAR）的新型框架。本方法利用关于区域功能的常识，并聚合环境记忆以构建功能三维场景图（F3DSG），该图将环境组织为功能区域及其关联容器。通过这一结构化表示，CMAR能够在宏观区域和微观容器两个层级实现层次化动作规划，使系统能够高效识别并检查语义相关的区域，从而实现有效的物体搜索。值得注意的是，CMAR持续融合实时感知、累积记忆和常识，以在动态变化的环境中重新定位物体。在仿真和真实环境中的大量实验表明，在动态交互环境中，CMAR-search在物体搜索的成功率和搜索效率上均显著超越最先进的基线方法。

Authors: Kaiyao Liao, Qingfeng Li, Xinlei Zhang, Chen Chen, Qing Sun, Jianwei Niu

Integrated Longitudinal and Lateral Control for High-Speed Platooning of Articulated Vehicles AutonomousDriving

high-speed platooning articulated vehicles string stability clothoid path tracking arc-length error

简要说明：本文提出一种用于铰接式车辆高速编队行驶的纵横向集成控制框架，包含基于PID的弦稳定纵向控制（采用弧长误差）和增强的clothoid横向路径跟踪（减少振荡、自适应前视距离），并通过仿真验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes an integrated longitudinal and lateral control framework for high-speed platooning of articulated vehicles, featuring a string-stable PID-based longitudinal controller with arc-length error formulation and an enhanced clothoid-based lateral controller for oscillation reduction and adaptive lookahead tuning, validated in simulations.

Abstract: This paper presents an integrated control framework for high-speed platooning of articulated vehicles, combining advanced longitudinal and lateral control strategies to address the challenges of safe and efficient autonomous driving. A novel proof of string stability for the proposed longitudinal control algorithm, based on a PID framework, ensures robust inter-vehicle distance regulation even under dynamic operating conditions. Additionally, an arc-length-based longitudinal error formulation enhances the applicability of the control system for curved roads, making it realistic for diverse driving scenarios. For lateral control, significant improvements to the clothoid-based path tracking algorithm are introduced to mitigate oscillations and enhance stability at high speeds. These enhancements include a tangential criterion for oscillation reduction, trajectory segment classification for adaptive lookahead distance tuning, a dual-adaptive mechanism for regulating the rate of lookahead distance adjustments based on both cross-track error (CTE) and anticipated road curvature, and extensions for articulated vehicle dynamics. The proposed integrated control framework is validated through simulations, demonstrating its effectiveness in maintaining stability, minimizing tracking errors, and ensuring robust performance in high-speed and challenging platooning scenarios.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种面向铰接式车辆高速编队行驶的集成控制框架，融合了先进的纵向与横向控制策略，以应对安全高效自动驾驶所面临的挑战。针对所提出的基于PID架构的纵向控制算法，本文给出了一种全新的队列稳定性证明，确保即使在动态工况下也能实现稳健的车间距调节。此外，基于弧长的纵向误差公式增强了控制系统在弯道场景中的适用性，使其更贴合多样化的实际行驶环境。在横向控制方面，本文对基于回旋曲线的路径跟踪算法进行了显著改进，以抑制振荡并提升高速下的稳定性。这些改进包括：用于减小振荡的切向判据、用于自适应前视距离调节的轨迹段分类机制、基于横向跟踪误差（CTE）与预测道路曲率的双自适应前视距离调节速率机制，以及针对铰接式车辆动力学的扩展。通过仿真验证了所提出集成控制框架的有效性，结果表明其在高速及复杂编队场景下能够保持稳定性、最小化跟踪误差，并确保控制的鲁棒性能。

Authors: Aashish Shaju, Steve Southward, Mehdi Ahmadian

Anticipating Social Consequences with Distributional World Models WorldModel

distributional world model social interactions multiple future prediction GRPO action selection

简要说明：提出了DSWM，一种分布性社会世界模型，能够为候选动作预测多种可能未来及其概率，通过SFT和GRPO在重复模拟上训练，在多个环境中提升了性能。

TLDR: Proposes DSWM, a distributional social world model that predicts multiple possible futures and their probabilities for candidate actions in social interactions, trained with SFT and GRPO on repeated simulations, improving performance across multiple environments.

Abstract: Social world models predict how interactions develop after an action, helping agents negotiate, cooperate and mediate. In these situations, one action can lead to several plausible futures, hence predicting only one future can overlook consequential alternatives, while exploring them through repeated simulations increases inference cost. We propose DSWM, a Distributional Social World Model that predicts alternative responses, their probabilities and immediate and final outcome values in one output per candidate action. We train a 4B model on repeated simulations using supervised fine-tuning and GRPO. At inference time, the actor uses these possible consequences to choose an action. Across three seen and two unseen environments, with interaction backbones absent from training collection, DSWM achieves the best average performance on 13 of 15 metrics. Ablations show that retaining multiple futures and their predicted probabilities improves outcomes in all five environments.

摘要（中文）：社交世界模型预测行动后交互如何发展，从而帮助智能体进行协商、合作与调解。在这些情境中，一个行动可能导向多种合理的未来结果，因此仅预测单一未来可能会忽略具有重要意义的备选方案，而通过重复模拟探索这些方案则会增加推理成本。我们提出DSWM，一种分布式社交世界模型，能够在每个候选行动的单一输出中预测多种备选响应、其概率以及即时和最终的结果值。我们利用监督微调和GRPO在重复模拟上训练了一个4B规模的模型。在推理时，行动者利用这些可能的后果来选择行动。在三个已见环境和两个未见环境中，交互骨干结构均未出现在训练数据集中，DSWM在15项指标中的13项上取得了最佳平均性能。消融实验表明，保留多种未来及其预测概率能改善所有五个环境中的任务效果。
